papers.abstract: We present TextSeal2, a distortion-free watermark for large language models that keeps its signal under speculative decoding: tokens that replace rejected drafts remain watermarked with the same keys, and the acceptance rate is unchanged. It also preserves output diversity and adds no measurable inference latency. Its predecessor, TextSeal, restores diversity in the Gumbel-max scheme by routing each token to one of two keys via a coin flip. This is suboptimal because the detector averages the scores from both keys without knowing which key was used. TextSeal2 instead merges two or more keys into a single virtual key and couples it to fresh noise through AutoMark's Gaussian copula. Any number of keys, including publicly shared keys, can be merged this way without diluting detection. Under speculative decoding, TextSeal2 verifies keyed drafts with one more exponential race, run on the leftovers of the draft races. By memorylessness, this race reproduces block verification, so the output follows the target model exactly. We evaluate TextSeal2 on three LLMs. At equal output token diversity, TextSeal2 detects 8 to 22 percentage points more 100-token answers than TextSeal at a false-positive rate of $10^{-3}$, and is comparable to textGrain while requiring no post-logits optimization. Under speculative decoding, it detects 18 and 22 percentage points more 200-token answers than TextSeal and textGrain, respectively, at the same acceptance rate.

analysis.key_results: 在相同输出token多样性下，TextSeal2在FPR=10^{-3}时比TextSeal多检测8至22个百分点的100-token答案；在推测解码下，对200-token答案的检测率比TextSeal和textGrain分别高18和22个百分点，且接受率相同。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出TextSeal2，一种无损LLM水印方法，可在推测解码下保持水印信号、不改变接受率且无额外推理延迟。
analysis.method: 将多个密钥合并为单个虚拟密钥，并通过AutoMark的高斯copula耦合到新噪声；在推测解码中利用指数竞争的剩余部分验证密钥草稿，通过无记忆性复现块验证。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: TextSeal2提出一种在推测解码下保持水印信号、不改变接受率且无额外推理延迟的无损LLM水印方法。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文核心是推测解码场景下的LLM水印方法，属于独立的高效推理技术，未直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人动作世界模型；但其推测解码兼容性可能对机器人模型的高效推理部署有间接方法论价值。

papers.abstract: A playable, programmable game world must maintain persistent state, enforce executable rules, and support extensible gameplay mechanics. Existing video world models can generate plausible combat, yet struggle to keep hit reactions and health updates consistent with game rules. We introduce Fight World Model (FWM), which separates rule-governed combat execution from video rendering. An executable engine maintains state and resolves interactions. A deterministic compiler encodes these outcomes and attempted actions in a spatially and temporally aligned interaction proxy. The proxy aligns action and skill windows, brief hit reactions, and persistent health by fighter identity and timing. These cues can be controlled separately to render interactions under modified rules. Identity-bound references preserve character appearance across side switches. We train FWM on FightWorld Corpus, spanning 52 skill effects, 187 character-appearance variants, and 15 arenas. Without retraining the renderer, FWM supports damage scaling, limited-hit immunity, lifesteal, and multi-stage skill mechanisms beyond the native game. It also allows character and arena customization. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of FWM, which outperforms existing game world models in action fidelity, hit reactions, health-state consistency, and character appearance preservation. Our project is available at https://fight-world-model.github.io.

analysis.key_results: 实验表明 FWM 在动作保真度、受击反应、生命值状态一致性和角色外观保持方面优于现有游戏世界模型，并支持伤害缩放、限时无敌、生命偷取和多阶段技能机制等原生游戏之外的功能。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出战斗世界模型（FWM），将规则驱动的战斗执行与视频渲染分离，并通过确定性编译生成时空对齐的交互代理，支持战斗交互的可控定制和规则一致性维护。
analysis.method: FWM 使用可执行引擎维护状态并解析交互，确定性编译器将结果和动作编码为时空对齐的交互代理，代理对齐动作与技能窗口、短暂受击反应和按身份与时机持续的生命值，并支持独立控制渲染和规则修改，身份绑定引用保持角色外观一致性。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出战斗世界模型（FWM），将规则驱动的战斗执行与视频渲染分离，通过确定性编译生成的交互代理，实现可定制且规则一致的格斗视频生成。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: FWM 是一个面向格斗游戏的视频世界模型，核心在于将确定性的规则引擎与渲染解耦，通过交互代理实现可控生成。它不直接涉及机器人操作或视觉-语言-动作模型，但对本站关注的世界模型中保持长期一致性和可控性的方法有借鉴价值。

The proxy and appearance references are encoded with a shared VAE and concatenated with video tokens. The DiT processes the combined sequence, and only video tokens are decoded to generate the continuation.

papers.abstract: Realistic, fast robotics simulations could enable large-scale training of embodied AI models that transfer to the real world. However, despite decades of progress, available simulations cover only a narrow range of real-world tasks and physical phenomena. The core bottleneck is that creating better simulations requires significant expert effort and therefore does not scale. To address this, we introduce Gym-Anything for Robotics, a framework in which coding agents create realistic robotics simulations. Our core insight is that simulation creation is a coding agent task, so improvements in coding agents translate directly into richer and more faithful simulations. We select simulations based on U.S. GDP data to cover economically valuable physical work, define what makes a good simulation and a good task, and develop an adversarial creation-audit loop that checks each simulation and task against these definitions. Using this pipeline, we build RoboWorld, a set of 25 simulations with 25 test and 175 training RL environments of varying difficulty. Even the best frontier models fail on every RoboWorld test task, achieving an average reward of only 0.06. Building on RoboWorld, we introduce several new ways for frontier models to improve, including in-context learning across repeated attempts, a privileged teacher that reads the simulator state and teaches a student in context, self-assisted learning from the model's own privileged experience, and code policies that generate demonstrations across varied scenes to train vision-language-action models (VLAs) such as $\pi_{0.5}$. Each of these substantially improves performance. We release our pipeline, RL environments, and benchmark to facilitate future research. Code and data are available at https://gym-anything.github.io/robotics

analysis.key_results: 前沿模型在RoboWorld测试任务上平均奖励仅为0.06；提出的多种新方法均能显著提升性能。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Gym-Anything for Robotics框架，利用编码智能体自动创建仿真，构建RoboWorld基准，并提出多种提升前沿模型性能的新方法，包括用于训练VLA的代码策略。
analysis.method: 基于编码智能体的对抗式创建-审计循环，结合GDP数据筛选仿真任务，并通过上下文学习、特权教师、自辅助学习和代码策略生成演示等新方法改进模型。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出一个通过编码智能体自动生成机器人仿真环境的框架，并构建了RoboWorld基准，用于训练和评估视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接相关：该工作构建仿真环境和基准来训练视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA），提出代码策略生成演示以训练VLA（如π0.5），是VLA数据生成与评估的重要基础设施。

papers.abstract: This study investigates the capabilities of Large Language Models to simulate counselling clients in educational role-plays in comparison to human role-players. Initially, we recorded role-playing sessions, where novice counsellors interacted with human peers acting as clients, followed by role-plays between humans and clients simulated by Mistrals Mixtral 8x7b using 4-bit quantization. These interactions were analysed with a counselling communication pattern system at sentence level. We investigated two key questions: (1) to what extent LLM-generated responses replicate authentic conversational dynamics and (2) whether counsellors' communication behaviour differs when interacting with human versus LLM-simulated clients. The findings highlight both similarities and differences in the application of counselling patterns across scenarios, showing the potential of LLM-based role-playing exercises to enhance counselling competencies and to identify areas for further refinement in virtual client simulations.

analysis.key_results: 发现人类与LLM模拟客户场景下咨询模式应用存在相似性和差异，表明基于LLM的角色扮演练习具有增强咨询能力的潜力。
analysis.main_contribution: 探索LLM模拟咨询客户在教育培训场景中的可行性，并分析了人类与LLM模拟客户互动中咨询模式应用的异同。
analysis.method: 使用4-bit量化Mistral Mixtral 8x7b模拟客户，与人类角色扮演对比，通过句子级咨询沟通模式系统分析对话。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该研究比较了人类角色扮演者与4-bit量化Mistral Mixtral 8x7b模拟客户在在线咨询训练中的对话模式差异。

papers.abstract: Mobile robots must open doors and drawers, yet their scene maps record what each object is and whether it has moved, not how it will respond to a pull. This paper proposes PhysVLMM, a method that maintains a physical belief for every articulated part of a Vision-Language-Motion Map and answers a planner's queries about it, with two algorithms: a map update and a query. Watching a part move provably cannot identify its dynamics, and a measured pull identifies only the pulled part, up to one direction. PhysVLMM therefore (i) keeps that direction as a posterior instead of a point estimate, (ii) passes the evidence of each pull in closed form to the untouched look-alike parts of the map, and (iii) answers whether an action will succeed at a stated risk, or abstains. On real doors and drawers in 18 homes, it identifies the joint type in 86% of held-out pulls (48% for a learned single-view method) and predicts the response to a pull with 41% lower error than differentiable simulation (CRPS 0.323 vs. 0.544), four orders of magnitude faster (13 ms vs. 230 s per case). The posterior lowers the final-position error from 0.460 to 0.270, sharing lowers the force error of untouched parts from 56% to 42%, and at every stated risk from 0.02 to 0.30 the false-safe answers stay within it. Pooling all measured parts of a home does as well as the look-alike groups, and simpler variants predict where a pulled part stops at least as well.

analysis.key_results: 在 18 个家庭的真实门和抽屉上，对留出的拉拽动作，关节类型识别准确率为 86%（单视角学习方法为 48%）；拉拽响应预测误差比可微仿真低 41%（CRPS 0.323 vs 0.544），速度快 4 个数量级（13 ms vs 230 s）；后验将最终位置误差从 0.460 降至 0.270；共享将未接触部件的力误差从 56% 降至 42%；在 0.02 至 0.30 的指定风险下，假安全回答保持在风险范围内；汇总所有测量部件与相似组效果相当；更简单的变体在预测拉拽停止位置方面至少同样好。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 PhysVLMM 方法，在机器人场景地图中对铰接物体的每个部件维护物理信念，并回答规划器的查询；包含地图更新和查询两种算法。
analysis.method: 维持拉拽方向的后验分布而非点估计；将每次拉拽的证据以封闭形式传递给地图中未接触的相似部件；以指定风险回答动作是否成功，否则弃权。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: PhysVLMM 在视觉-语言-运动地图中为铰接部件维护物理信念，通过后验更新与查询回答动作是否成功。

papers.abstract: How effectively can vision-language-action (VLA) models learn diverse language-conditioned behaviors as training data scales? Investigating this question requires large and varied robot datasets, whose collection on physical robots remains costly. We introduce BURGER, a language-conditioned robotic drawing benchmark with a scalable, prompt-driven pipeline for generating continuous drawing trajectories, both in simulation and the real world. In BURGER, an agent starts from the same blank canvas and controls a robot arm to draw the object or spatial composition specified by language, while each instruction allows an open-ended variety of valid drawings and stroke orders. Using 28,200 simulated demonstrations spanning 282 drawing tasks, we evaluate five representative VLA models across data scales, language grounding, and multimodal behavior. BURGER supports fine-grained analysis of language grounding, spatial composition, and action generation, revealing distinct failure patterns across VLA models. Our experiments suggest that some VLA models can benefit from greater task diversity and demonstration scale, capture multimodal drawing behaviors, and generalize to unseen compositions of familiar objects. Finally, we deploy a trained policy on a Franka Panda arm, demonstrating the ability to draw reactively under human intervention. Project homepage and code can be found at https://siyingzhao.github.io/BURGER/.

analysis.key_results: 部分VLA模型能从更大的任务多样性和演示规模中受益，捕捉多模态绘画行为，并泛化到熟悉物体的未知组合；在Franka Panda上部署训练策略，实现人类干预下的反应式绘画。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入一个可扩展的、提示驱动的机器人绘画基准BURGER，在仿真和现实中生成连续轨迹，并用于系统评估VLA模型的泛化能力。
analysis.method: 使用提示驱动管线生成28200个仿真演示，覆盖282个绘画任务，在相同初始画布上由语言指定物体或空间组合进行绘制；用五种代表性VLA模型在数据规模、语言基础和模态行为上进行评估。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出BURGER基准，通过语言引导的机器人绘画任务评估VLA模型的数据扩展、语言基础和泛化能力。

papers.abstract: Fine-grained manipulation requires a robot policy to follow instructions, remain robust to visual variations, and translate predicted actions into precise robot control. We present Demonstration Expansion and Execution Design (DEED), a framework for adapting a pretrained vision-language-action policy to the five MetaFine tasks through structured demonstration expansion and execution design. DEED generates demonstrations for different instructions from the same initial scene and renders each physical trajectory under different camera positions and lighting conditions while preserving its original states and action targets. A hierarchical sampling strategy balances instructions, trajectories, and visual conditions during supervised adaptation. At deployment, DEED converts predicted action chunks into robot commands using inverse kinematics, gripper mappings selected for each task, and closed-loop replanning. DEED achieves an official Overall score of 85.55%. Fixed-policy evaluations show that performance varies with execution horizon, denoising budget, and gripper mapping.

analysis.key_results: 官方总分85.55%；固定策略评估显示性能随执行范围、去噪预算和夹爪映射而变化。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出DEED框架，通过演示扩展（同一初始场景不同指令生成演示，并在不同相机位置和光照条件下渲染轨迹）和执行设计（逆运动学、任务特定夹爪映射、闭环重规划）适配预训练VLA策略到MetaFine任务。
analysis.method: 结构化演示扩展和分层采样策略进行监督适配；部署时将预测动作块转换为机器人控制命令。

papers.abstract: We introduce Continuous-Action World Models (CoAWM), a framework for learning cross-embodiment spatiotemporal dynamics priors that support robot action generation across embodiments and execution frequencies. At its core is a shared latent function space that captures the spatial and temporal structure of robot actions. We learn this space through two stages. First, function pretraining brings trajectories from different embodiments and sampling frequencies into a common representation, learning shared dynamics priors through action reconstruction and consistency across temporal sampling views. By accommodating heterogeneous robot trajectories, this stage broadens the range of data sources available for pretraining and facilitates scaling to larger and more diverse datasets. Second, we connect the pretrained function space to a world-model backbone, enabling observations, language instructions, and the current robot state to condition the prediction of a latent action function. A single decoder takes any query time and returns the corresponding end-effector action. By separating shared dynamics priors from task-conditioned action selection and temporal sampling, our approach provides a unified foundation for transferring robot experience across embodiments and control frequencies.

analysis.key_results: 摘要未说明
analysis.main_contribution: 提出CoAWM框架，通过共享潜在函数空间捕获机器人动作的时空结构，实现跨具身和控制频率的动作生成与经验迁移。
analysis.method: 两阶段学习：首先通过函数预训练将不同具身和采样频率的轨迹映射到统一表示，利用动作重建和时序视图一致性学习共享动态先验；然后将预训练函数空间连接到世界模型骨干，基于观测、语言指令和当前状态预测潜在动作函数，解码器按任意查询时间输出末端执行器动作。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated promising capabilities in robotic manipulation by integrating visual perception, language understanding, and action generation. Recent advances have further incorporated future prediction to enhance the understanding of environmental dynamics and task progression. However, existing methods often model short-term dynamics and long-term task objectives separately, while directly incorporating predicted futures into action policies without sufficiently considering their relevance to current action requirements. To address these limitations, we propose HiFOR, a hierarchical foresight framework with action-guided world retrieval. Specifically, Hierarchical Foresight Prediction jointly predicts short-term state evolution, semantic milestones, and final goal states through a Hierarchical Dependency Mask (HDM), establishing dependencies across temporal horizons. Building upon these predictions, Structure-Aware Latent World Modeling organizes future latent representations along the horizon, view, and spatial dimensions to facilitate fine-grained retrieval. Furthermore, Action-Guided Factorized World Retrieval adaptively retrieves relevant future information from the structured latent world based on evolving action representations during denoising, providing targeted guidance for action generation. Extensive experiments on two simulation benchmarks and six real-world robotic manipulation tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.

papers.abstract: In-context imitation learning (ICIL) adapts robot policies through test-time demonstrations, but long multimodal trajectories constrain how many examples fit in context. We ask what a compressed demonstration should preserve. We propose JEDI, which compresses demonstrations into latent slots trained to predict the query episode's next-stage keyframe in a frozen video-JEPA space. Task and process counterfactuals help the slots preserve execution details, while the predictor selects demonstrations from a bank. Post-training with keypoint tokens enables human-hand conditioning on robots. Experiments on LIBERO and real robots show that JEDI supports many-shot context; LIBERO objective controls show improved success and demonstration following over action-only compression. These findings support query-future prediction as a training objective for preserving execution-relevant information in compressed demonstrations.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO和真实机器人上，JEDI支持多示例上下文；LIBERO目标控制显示，相比仅动作压缩，JEDI在成功率和演示跟随性上均有提升。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出JEDI方法，利用冻结的video-JEPA空间中的关键帧预测目标将演示压缩为潜在槽，以实现上下文模仿学习中保留执行相关信息的压缩演示。
analysis.method: 将演示压缩为潜在槽，训练其预测查询片段的下一阶段关键帧；利用任务和过程反事实帮助槽保留执行细节，预测器从演示库中选择演示；通过关键点令牌后训练实现人手到机器人的条件化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出JEDI，通过将机器人演示压缩为潜在槽并预测查询片段的下一阶段关键帧，在上下文模仿学习中以压缩演示支持多示例上下文，并在模拟和真实机器人上验证了效果。

papers.abstract: Human demonstrations offer an efficient and scalable source of data for dexterous robot manipulation, but differences in sensing and hand morphology complicate the transfer of contact-rich interactions. We present TouchBridge, a hardware--software co-designed framework for human-to-robot data transformation. A wearable human demonstration interface and a corresponding robot interface establish cross-embodiment correspondence in visual and fingertip tactile sensing. We introduce Tac-Retarget, a tactile-conditioned retargeting method that uses measured contact to align fingertip contact patches and preserve their spatial relations within and across hands. Unlike object-aware or simulation-based transfer pipelines, Tac-Retarget requires no object mesh, object-pose estimate, or physics simulation for retargeting, enabling direct and scalable conversion of human demonstrations into robot-domain training data. Combined with visual synthesis and camera-anchored action conversion, TouchBridge produces robot-domain demonstrations for fine-tuning a pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) model. Across four real-world contact-rich tasks, policies fine-tuned solely on TouchBridge-converted human demonstrations achieve a 72.5% average success rate, compared with 77.5% using an equal number of teleoperated robot demonstrations, while human demonstration collection is 7.0x faster. Under the same policy and training setup, Tac-Retarget outperforms DexPilot and UniDex by 25.0 and 42.5 percentage points, respectively.

papers.abstract: Low-bit quantization enables efficient deployment of large language models by reducing memory footprint and computational cost. Achieving high accuracy at low precision requires selecting quantization ranges, linear transformations, and weight rounding decisions. Existing approaches typically optimize these components independently using local reconstruction objectives, which fail to account for the varying impact of quantization errors on downstream predictions. Direct optimization of task-level metrics would provide a more faithful objective, but is challenging due to the discontinuous nature of quantization operations and the high computational cost of evaluating their downstream effects. In this work, we derive a Hessian-guided approximation of the output change induced by joint weight and activation quantization. Based on a tractable Fisher approximation, we formulate a unified post-training quantization framework that enables the joint optimization of quantization ranges, linear transformations, and weight rounding under a common output-sensitivity objective. The resulting method remains practical for modern large language models and consistently outperforms state-of-the-art transformation and rounding methods across both channel-wise and block-wise quantization settings.

analysis.main_contribution: 推导出权重和激活联合量化引起的输出变化的Hessian引导近似，并基于可处理的Fisher近似构建统一的后训练量化框架，能够在一个共同的目标下联合优化量化范围、线性变换和权重舍入。
analysis.method: 利用Hessian引导的近似和Fisher近似，联合优化量化范围、线性变换和权重舍入，形成一个统一的后训练量化框架。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种基于Hessian引导和Fisher近似的统一后训练量化框架，联合优化量化范围、线性变换和权重舍入，以提高大型语言模型低比特量化的精度。

papers.abstract: Recent advances in video world models have enabled the generation of increasingly realistic and interactive virtual environments, opening new possibilities for player-customizable gameplay. Agentic frameworks further advance this direction by decoupling explicit game logic and controllable world representations from visual generation. However, existing approaches support only simple game settings and predefined motion patterns, generalize poorly to unseen environments and characters, and offer limited real-time interactivity. In this paper, we introduce Wizard, an agentic game world model that enables real-time, precise control over character motions while generalizing zero-shot across novel scenes, characters, and actions. To achieve this, we construct a diverse dataset spanning 750 scenes and 178 characters, incorporating skeleton and geometry information as structured representations. We leverage these representations as intermediate proxies to condition a video generation model, together with an adaptive masking mechanism that improves alignment between the conditioning signals and generated video rollouts. Furthermore, we introduce an agentic framework that explicitly maintains and updates game states, allowing players to freely configure their virtual worlds and exercise fine-grained control over character motions while preserving visual quality and gameplay consistency. By combining agentic control with structured proxy-based generation, our framework unlocks new possibilities for player-driven game creation with real-time, generalizable, and mechanically consistent world simulation.

papers.abstract: Large language model serving is limited by facility power. Energy per token determines how many tokens a datacenter can serve, while a latency target bounds how quickly each user receives them. During decode, every weight is read from memory for every generated token. Batching amortizes this read across users but makes no individual user faster. Speculative decoding does: a drafter proposes several future tokens, and the target model verifies them in a single forward pass that reuses the same weight read. Because every drafted token must be verified whether or not it is accepted, the energy speculation saves depends on how many drafted tokens are accepted. This saving is hard to pin down. It varies across target models from different attention families and across drafting schemes, and it depends on the text being served. Every drafter we evaluate accepts fewer tokens on conversation than on code, and every trained drafter accepts fewer on Romansh, a low-resource language, than on English. We measure speculative decoding under production serving conditions (SGLang, CUDA graphs enabled) on H100 and H200 GPUs, at batch sizes up to 64 across 5 corpora. On dense models, verification, not drafting, dominates the energy cost. The saving shrinks as the batch grows, because batching has already shared the weight read that speculation would divide among the accepted tokens. At large batch sizes, block drafters push verification past the balance point between arithmetic and memory traffic into the compute-bound regime, where the saving becomes a loss, and a drafter with low acceptance raises energy per token. Meeting a tighter latency target with speculation then costs additional energy. Larger batches lower energy per token without speculation. Speculation adds to that saving only when acceptance is high, and on the model we tested it leaves little headroom for latency-preserving DVFS.

papers.abstract: Building general game agents requires both high-level task reasoning and low-latency action control in rapidly changing visual environments. These capabilities favor models with substantially different computational profiles, making them difficult to realize within a single model. In this work, we present TaskFrame, a hierarchical planner-controller framework that connects task-level planning with frame-level keyboard-and-mouse control. A vision-language task planner decomposes a high-level goal into an ordered sequence of atomic instructions and is optimized through supervised learning and dependency-aware GRPO. The hidden states of special goal tokens that terminate each atomic instruction provide continuous goal embeddings that are cached and reused across control steps. A causal Transformer controller combines the embedding of the active goal with recent observations to predict discrete keyboard and mouse-button actions and continuous camera motion at every game step. We train the system in three stages: planner training, controller pretraining, and joint alignment. Experiments in Minecraft show that TaskFrame is competitive with general-purpose vision-language models on instruction decomposition, and that in closed-loop evaluation the agent achieves a higher combat success rate than the evaluated baselines.

analysis.key_results: 在Minecraft中，TaskFrame在指令分解上与通用视觉语言模型相当，在闭环评估中战斗成功率高于所比较的基线。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出TaskFrame框架，通过缓存目标标记的隐藏状态将任务级规划与帧级键盘鼠标控制结合，并在Minecraft中验证其有效性。

papers.abstract: Flow policies are among the strongest robot controllers and are well suited to modelling multimodal action distributions. Our analysis shows that the continuous-action distributions of the studied flow policies are well approximated by Gaussians. We propose the Gaussian Action Readout (GAR), which replaces a flow policy's final layer with a Gaussian readout trained on just 0.02% of eligible states, while keeping the rest of the network frozen. It samples with one action-network pass, gives closed-form likelihoods, and achieves near-teacher task success at up to twice the inference speed.

papers.abstract: Synthetic data are widely used for training modern AI systems. However, their statistical understanding remains limited. It is well recognized in statistics that repeated self-training on synthetic data can amplify errors inherited from pre-trained models, leading to model collapse. Verification plays a crucial role in selecting high-quality synthetic data to help prevent model collapse and improve model performance. We study verified self-training in a linear regression framework, where a pre-trained estimator generates synthetic data with injected generation noise and a verifier selects samples according to a verification threshold. Post-training on the accepted samples updates either all coordinates (full fine-tuning) or only an active subset (partial fine-tuning). Our analysis reveals three potentially counterintuitive effects. We establish that tighter verification does not always lead to lower prediction risk. We also find that a suitable level of injected generation noise can reduce prediction risk, while excessive noise can increase it. Moreover, full and partial fine-tuning can respond differently to the same verification rule, since pre-training error in the frozen coordinates affects both sample selection and post-training risk. We analyze these effects by deriving finite sample risk bounds for four separate regimes determined by the relative scales of the verification threshold, generation noise, and pre-training error. The bounds precisely characterize how verification affects prediction risk across these regimes. In particular, we quantify how the generation noise, the effective accepted sample size, and the covariance of the accepted covariates affect prediction risk. The analysis extends to iterative verified full fine-tuning, where sufficiently tight verification reduces the initial error contribution at a geometric rate.

analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文在带验证的合成数据自训练线性回归框架中，研究了更严格的验证、注入噪声和微调方式对预测风险的影响。

papers.abstract: Video generation is shifting from end-to-end synthesis toward agentic generation, where planning, tool use, and feedback enable coherent, controllable multi-shot videos. In parallel, video world models provide action-conditioned observations and predicted futures, serving as interactive environments for agents. We study their intersection through the agent harness: an executable runtime that constructs context, exposes tools, maintains state, routes feedback, and manages budgets around video models. This report examines three directions. First, agentic video generation, where harnesses coordinate scripting, shot planning, asset management, production, and editing, alongside the evaluation challenges of these systems. Second, agentic world modeling, where harnesses mediate observation, control, execution, and state. We discuss hybrid designs in which game engines or agent-written programs maintain world state while video models render observations, and how agents and world models can mutually evaluate and improve one another. Third, recursive self-improvement (RSI) in video model development, distinguishing output revisions, updates to harness state, generator parameters, and evaluators, and changes to the improvement procedure itself. We identify how these improvements feed back into subsequent development. Across these directions, we analyze essential agent capabilities, including audiovisual perception, long-horizon planning, memory, code-based interaction, feedback-guided control, skill reuse, and multi-agent coordination. We conclude with challenges in autonomous video production, lifelong memory, programmable hybrid control, autonomous model development, provenance, cost accounting, and evaluation linking video quality and task performance to sustained improvements in models and harnesses.

papers.abstract: Unified multimodal models can both generate and understand images within a single set of weights, offering an opportunity to use image synthesis as training supervision for visual comprehension. However, existing visual chain-of-thought methods rely on human-annotated helper images during training and require slow image generation at test time. We present SelfThinker, the first self-evolving framework that turns a unified model's self-generated visual thoughts into stronger understanding without human image annotations. Given a visual problem, SelfThinker samples candidate helper images from its generation pathway and uses its frozen understanding pathway to score each candidate via conditional pointwise mutual information. High-utility visual thoughts then refine the generator via flow matching and serve as privileged teacher context for on-policy self-distillation. At inference, SelfThinker reasons directly from the original image in text without generating intermediate images. Although trained only on small synthetic visual-search and navigation datasets, SelfThinker transfers broadly to natural-image and spatial benchmarks, raising the seven-benchmark average of ThinkMorph-7B from 52.7 to 64.0 (+11.3 points). Controlled image-perturbation probes further show that SelfThinker surpasses ThinkMorph-7B by up to 40.4 points and its pretrained BAGEL-7B backbone by up to 23.2 points across fine-grained and spatial perception tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/zhangquanchen/SelfThinker.

analysis.key_results: 在七个基准上平均分数从 52.7 提升至 64.0（+11.3）；控制图像扰动探测中，在细粒度和空间感知任务上分别超越 ThinkMorph-7B 最多 40.4 分、超越 BAGEL-7B 主干最多 23.2 分。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 SelfThinker，首个无需人类图像标注的自进化框架，利用模型自身的生成通路采样辅助图像，并用冻结的理解通路评分筛选高质量视觉思维，进而通过流匹配和自蒸馏提升模型理解能力。
analysis.method: 从生成通路采样候选辅助图像，用冻结理解通路计算条件点互信息评分；高价值视觉思维用于流匹配微调生成器和作为特权教师上下文进行在线策略自蒸馏；推理时直接从原图文本推理，不生成中间图像。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: SelfThinker 提出一种自进化框架，让统一多模态模型利用自身生成的视觉思维来增强视觉理解，无需人工标注。

papers.abstract: Activation steering changes what a language model generates by editing its hidden states at inference time. Its most common form adds one vector, the difference of class means (DiM), to every hidden state. CHaRS (concept heterogeneity-aware representation steering) uses optimal transport instead: an entropic plan pairs the clusters of the two classes, and each hidden state moves along a mixture of the cluster displacements, weighted toward its nearest clusters. We study this family of clustered optimal-transport maps for toxicity mitigation in Gemma-2-2B and Granite-3.1-2B, and ask what the plan adds to DiM and whether that survives INT8 and NF4 quantization. We prove an identity: whatever the plan, the displacements averaged with the cluster sizes as weights equal DiM, so a clustered map can differ from DiM only for tokens whose routing weights depart from the cluster sizes. In the CHaRS protocol they stay close, and CHaRS is statistically equivalent to Mean-AcT, which adds DiM at every layer, in all eight pre-specified equivalence tests. A variant fitted on individual tokens, which routes each token mainly to its nearest clusters, leaves 37-39% less toxicity than DiM on Gemma and 51-61% less on Granite at steering strength 3 (toxic-bert), where DiM already removes 76-85% of it. Two other toxicity classifiers confirm the gain on Granite, but on Gemma only one does. At equal strength the variant has somewhat higher perplexity, but at matched toxicity it is slightly more fluent than DiM. Yet a nearly constant map from the same clusters also leaves about 30% less toxicity, so the role of treating tokens differently remains open. Under INT8 and NF4 the variant still leaves less toxicity than DiM, and transferring it from full precision to the NF4 model instead of refitting it adds no significant toxicity after correction for multiple tests.

analysis.key_results: CHaRS 在预设等效测试中与 Mean-AcT 统计等效；按 token 路由的变体在毒性缓解上优于 DiM（Gemma 上毒性降低 37-39%，Granite 上降低 51-61%），但困惑度略高；在 INT8 和 NF4 下变体仍优于 DiM，且从全精度迁移到 NF4 模型无显著毒性增加。
analysis.limitations: 几乎恒定的映射也能减少约 30% 毒性，表明对不同 token 差异化处理的作用仍不确定。
analysis.main_contribution: 系统性研究了聚类最优传输激活引导（CHaRS）与均值差（DiM）的关系，证明簇大小加权的位移平均恒等于 DiM，并评估了变体在毒性缓解和量化下的性能。
analysis.method: 使用聚类最优传输（CHaRS）与均值差（DiM）激活引导，在 Gemma-2-2B 和 Granite-3.1-2B 上进行毒性缓解实验，并测试 INT8 和 NF4 量化后的效果。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 研究基于聚类最优传输的激活引导方法（CHaRS）在毒性缓解中的效果，并检验其在 INT8 和 NF4 量化下的稳健性。

papers.abstract: Memory in reinforcement learning raises two problems. Attention finds the relevant item by scoring the whole store, which is costly for robots under latency and energy limits. When a retrieved memory pays off, credit for acquiring it must cross the whole sequence. We argue that both are governed by one quantity, the value of information, and propose to estimate it from archived rollouts with a learned world model. We obtain that, when read at the observation, it yields a provable lower bound on the optimal value of the acquiring action, which floors its TD target and attributes this floor to the observation that earned it. Read at the decision, it defines the optimal retrieval set. A pilot retrieval system, to be trained and improved with this signal, solves a memory task with reduced context.

papers.abstract: Choosing a robot action model requires evidence about task capability, adaptation cost, deployment requirements, and the reliability of reported conclusions. Success rates alone offer limited guidance to researchers with different computing budgets and goals. We propose RoboSeed, a multidimensional evaluation framework for vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models (WAM), within a continuing program to train, evaluate, and openly release robot models with verifiable evidence for model selection. The framework defines five dimensions: capability, downstream training affordability, deployment affordability, locally verified research value, and reproduction evidence. It maps empirical measurements and audit criteria to 0-100 profiles using fixed normalization anchors, with balanced, training-constrained, and deployment-constrained preference settings. Interface and protocol checks establish when comparisons are appropriate. Missing measurements remain explicit, incomplete aggregate scores are withheld, and weighted input coverage identifies evidence gaps. We apply the framework to representative VLA and WAM models, drawing on local training, released-weight evaluation, task-level audits, and an evaluation-system study. The results reveal budget-dependent backbone choices, sensitivity to adaptation recipes, and differences between language and visual task interfaces. Reproducible scoring code and machine-readable evidence support extension to additional models. The study provides dimension-level assessments and priorities for further measurement, while incomplete serving traces and heterogeneous protocols preclude overall numerical rankings.

analysis.key_results: 应用框架于代表性 VLA 和 WAM 模型后发现：骨干网络选择依赖于预算，结果对适应配方敏感，语言与视觉任务接口间存在差异；由于服务轨迹不完整和协议异质性，未给出整体数值排名。
analysis.limitations: 摘要指出不完整的服务轨迹和异构协议妨碍了整体数值排名。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了 RoboSeed 评估框架，对 VLA 和 WAM 进行多维度的量化评估，定义五个维度并映射到0-100分，支持多种偏好设置，同时处理缺失数据和协议可比性问题。
analysis.method: 该框架定义五个维度：能力、下游训练可负担性、部署可负担性、本地验证研究价值和复现证据；使用固定归一化锚点将经验测量和审计标准映射到0-100分数，支持均衡、训练受限和部署受限的偏好设置，并通过接口和协议检查确保比较的适当性。

papers.abstract: Agentic robots must turn a high-level goal into actions while keeping the physical conditions needed for future steps valid. A completed action does not ensure that its effects will persist: a later disturbance can invalidate support that the remaining plan still assumes. We present LOGIV, a graph engineering framework for agentic robot execution that uses an explicit task graph to connect symbolic planning, observation-based verification, and embodied action. LOGIV compiles a validated plan into condition-support and resource-ordering edges, checks their physical validity during execution, and uses dependency tracing to determine what must be restored after a failure. Repair is constrained by retained unfinished actions, and the combined continuation is symbolically validated before execution resumes. The framework operates above existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) and World Action Model (WAM) policies without adding trainable components. Across 20 dual-arm tasks from RoboTwin~V2 and BiCoord with three execution backbones, LOGIV improves mean task success without injected disturbances by 10.67 and 15.33 percentage points, respectively. Under predefined perturbations, it achieves higher task completion and condition restoration than three adapted recovery baselines for every backbone on both benchmarks. On three real-robot tasks, successful trials increase from 12/30 to 17/30. These results support explicit, continuously checked task dependencies as a practical interface for reliable agentic robot execution.

analysis.key_results: 在RoboTwin V2和BiCoord共20个双臂任务上，LOGIV在无注入扰动下使平均任务成功率分别提升10.67和15.33个百分点；在预定义扰动下任务完成率和条件恢复率优于三种恢复基线；在三个真实机器人任务中成功试验从12/30提升到17/30。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出LOGIV图工程框架，通过显式任务图在VLA和WAM策略之上提供无训练的可靠执行与因果局部修复能力。
analysis.method: LOGIV将经验证的计划编译为条件-支撑和资源-排序边，执行中检查物理有效性，利用依赖追踪确定故障后需恢复的内容，并对保留未完成动作的修复方案进行符号验证。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: LOGIV利用显式任务图连接符号规划、基于观测的验证和具身动作，通过依赖追踪实现长时程机器人任务的可靠执行和因果局部修复。

papers.abstract: Reasoning vision-language-action (VLA) policies write a reasoning trace and then decode the action from it. A wrong trace yields a wrong action, and even a correct-looking trace can mislead the plan. Existing remedies ask whether the reasoning is right. We ask how strongly it should steer. CoC-CFG applies classifier-free guidance between the policy's context and the same context without the reasoning span. One weight per Euler step attenuates or amplifies the reasoning, and w=1 recovers the original policy. We treat the choice of this weight as a Markov decision process whose action values are measured, not bootstrapped. With the expert frozen and the noise fixed, applying a weight for one step and finishing the plan under the current controller returns that weight's value exactly. Q-adaptive guidance fits these values with small critics and improves the controller conservatively. In the Alpasim driving simulator it outperforms every fixed weight and online RL (SAC, GRPO) in open loop, and in closed loop it passes 262 of 300 scenes, against 252 for the original policy. On held-out frames of the Waymo end-to-end driving benchmark, its first three stages outperform every fixed weight, four adaptive-guidance methods, SAC and GRPO. On the hidden test set, a frozen Alpamayo 1.5 with rule-based camera and vehicle conversions and Q-adaptive guidance sets a new state of the art among published methods: 8.135159 rater feedback score, against 8.079 for the best published method.

analysis.key_results: 在 Alpasim 驾驶模拟器中，开环性能超过所有固定权重和在线 RL（SAC、GRPO），闭环通过 262/300 场景（原始策略为 252）；在 Waymo 端到端驾驶基准的 held-out 帧上前三个阶段超过所有固定权重、四种自适应引导方法、SAC 和 GRPO；在隐藏测试集上，冻结的 Alpamayo 1.5 配合基于规则的摄像头和车辆转换及 Q-adaptive guidance 取得 8.135159 的评分，超过最佳已发表方法的 8.079。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 CoC-CFG 方法，利用分类器无关引导在 VLA 策略中调节推理信息的影响，并将权重选择建模为马尔可夫决策过程，其动作价值由测量而非 bootstrapping 获得，进而用小型 critic 实现 Q-adaptive guidance。
analysis.method: CoC-CFG：在策略上下文与移除推理跨度的同一上下文之间应用分类器无关引导；每个 Euler 步使用一个权重衰减或放大推理；权重选择视为 MDP，动作值通过冻结专家和固定噪声的逐步执行精确测量；Q-adaptive guidance 用小型 critic 拟合动作值并保守改进控制器。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出 CoC-CFG 与 Q-adaptive guidance，通过可测动作价值函数自适应调整 VLA 策略中推理轨迹对动作解码的影响强度。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接针对 VLA（视觉-语言-动作）策略，研究如何调节推理轨迹对动作解码的影响，属于 VLA 策略优化范畴，但不涉及世界模型或动作世界建模。

Held at every step, a larger weight turns the plan of (b) harder and carries the plan of (c) farther. (b) On a held-out scene of the Alpasim driving simulator the reasoning calls for a lane change the scene does not offer; the original model (red) follows it off the recorded path (green). (c) This reasoning reads correctly, yet followed at full strength the plan runs far ahead of the recorded drive. In both, ours (blue; Q-adaptive guidance trained in Alpasim) attenuates the reasoning.

papers.title: How Much Should a VLA Trust Its Reasoning? Step-Level Guidance as a Measured Action-Value Function
papers.title_zh: VLA 应多信任其推理：将逐步引导视为可测动作价值函数

papers.abstract: Linear attention stores historical information in a recurrent state of fixed size, providing a compact memory representation for long-context inference. Reducing state precision further lowers per-request storage requirements, but quantized writeback errors enter subsequent recurrences, degrade prediction quality on long-reasoning tasks, and can be accompanied by repetitive generation and excessively long outputs. We propose Global Gradient-aware Allocation (GGA) and the Pure-Write Sliding Window (PW) to address precision allocation and recent-information maintenance. GGA combines candidate quantization residuals with gradient sensitivity to future prediction loss to allocate head bit widths under a model-wide mixed-precision budget. PW independently maintains recent pure writes as FP8 vector pairs, propagates them through the full GDN state transition, and merges them into the low-bit historical state only after they leave the window. Across seven evaluations on Qwen3.5-4B/9B, GGA allocation alone improves over STEPQuant@4 by 19.48/29.84 percentage points. Adding PW-S8 yields seven-task macro-averages of 69.83%/78.63%, improving over STEPQuant@4 by 38.39/41.21 percentage points, respectively. Both precision reallocation and window maintenance improve task scores while mitigating excessively long outputs: at @6, GGA reduces mean generation length, averaged equally across tasks, by 10.45%/14.65% relative to STEPQuant; adding PW-S8 to GGA@4 further reduces mean generation length by 32.32%/36.77%. Comparisons at similar storage budgets further show that using additional capacity to maintain recent writes yields higher task scores and shorter mean outputs than solely increasing the bit width of the accumulated state.

analysis.key_results: 在Qwen3.5-4B/9B的七项评估上，GGA单独比STEPQuant@4提升19.48/29.84个百分点；GGA加PW-S8的七项任务宏平均为69.83%/78.63%，比STEPQuant@4提升38.39/41.21个百分点。两种方法都提高了任务分数并缓解输出过长问题。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出全局梯度感知分配（GGA）和纯写滑动窗口（PW）两种方法，分别用于混合精度下的头比特宽度分配和近期信息维护，以改进低比特GDN循环状态量化在长推理任务上的表现。
analysis.method: GGA利用候选量化残差与未来预测损失的梯度敏感性分配头比特宽度；PW独立维护近期纯写为FP8向量对，经完整GDN状态转移传播，仅在离开窗口后合并入低比特历史状态。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出全局梯度感知分配（GGA）和纯写滑动窗口（PW），以缓解低比特循环状态量化中由写回误差引起的长推理任务性能下降和输出过长问题。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文属于独立模型量化研究，未直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人策略，但其降低循环状态存储需求的方法可为高效推理提供参考，对机器人世界模型中的长上下文记忆压缩可能具有方法论价值。

papers.title: Low-Bit GDN Recurrent-State Quantization: Global Gradient-aware Allocation and Pure-Write Sliding Windows
papers.title_zh: 低比特GDN循环状态量化：全局梯度感知分配与纯写滑动窗口

papers.abstract: KV cache quantization is well studied for autoregressive language models, where cached prefix states are exact under causal attention and quantization is mainly a cache reconstruction problem. Diffusion language models (dLLMs) break this assumption. Fast dLLM inference reuses KV states across denoising steps, but bidirectional token representations can change as masked tokens are revealed, so the reused cache may already differ from full recomputation before quantization is applied. We study KV cache quantization under this cache-reuse error. We adapt KIVI and KVQuant to Fast-dLLM-style prefix and dual cache reuse, and introduce TRACE and dLLM-KVQ. TRACE reconstructs feasible dLLM reveal trajectories from prompt-answer pairs, providing calibration states that match iterative masked decoding. dLLM-KVQ uses these trajectories to choose per-layer K-cache entries that remain in high precision according to output- and attention-level behavior metrics, while applying standard low-bit value quantization. Across LLaDA and Dream evaluations on GSM8K, HumanEval, MATH, and MBPP, dLLM-KVQ achieves the highest average score among quantized methods across the reported 4-bit and 2-bit prefix/dual cache settings.

analysis.key_results: 在GSM8K、HumanEval、MATH和MBPP上的LLaDA和Dream评估中，dLLM-KVQ在报告的4位和2位前缀/双缓存设置下获得量化方法中的最高平均得分。
analysis.main_contribution: 针对扩散语言模型特有的KV缓存复用误差，提出TRACE和dLLM-KVQ两种方法，实现高效的KV缓存量化。
analysis.method: TRACE从提示-答案对重建可行的揭示轨迹以提供校准状态；dLLM-KVQ利用这些轨迹根据输出和注意力行为指标选择保留高精度的每层K缓存条目，同时应用标准低位值量化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 研究扩散语言模型在缓存复用误差下的KV缓存量化，提出TRACE和dLLM-KVQ方法以提升低位量化性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 无直接关系；本文聚焦于扩散语言模型的KV缓存量化，不涉及VLA、WAM或机器人领域，但其建模缓存复用误差的量化技术可能对高效推理有参考价值。

(b) The reused cache can differ from the corresponding full-recompute cache after masked tokens inside the block are revealed.

papers.abstract: Visual grounding is crucial for robots to understand language instructions with visual observations. This paper addresses the problem of visual grounding uncertainties, where a robot uses a black-box vision-language model (VLM) to ground free-form natural-language instructions to target objects. Prevailing methods derive uncertainty from the VLM itself. Yet, outputs of the VLM, e.g., generated uncertainties, are from the same parameters and structures producing the predictions, and inherit the bias. We give a formal Bayesian definition of the problem that treats the VLM prediction as an observation. An external surrogate Bayesian model then quantifies per-query uncertainty over a local neighborhood of a held-out calibration set, decomposed into aleatoric and epistemic components. A hierarchical retrieval across input modalities realizes a compact joint-space neighborhood, mitigating the curse of dimensionality. The estimator further integrates with conformal prediction or model-based planning for active visual grounding, where robots are allowed to take verbal or physical actions to ground targets. Across grounding benchmarks and state-of-the-art VLMs, it consistently improves both calibration and task performance. On a real Fetch robot under open-world instructions, it enables principled trade-offs between confident action and information gathering, substantially improving robustness.

analysis.key_results: 在多个视觉定位基准和先进VLM上，一致提升校准和任务性能；在真实Fetch机器人开放世界指令下实现置信行动与信息收集的权衡，显著提高鲁棒性。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种替代贝叶斯不确定性估计器，将黑盒VLM的预测视为观测，在局部校准集上分解偶然和认知不确定性，并支持主动视觉定位。
analysis.method: 形式化贝叶斯定义，使用外部替代贝叶斯模型进行不确定性估计，采用跨模态层次检索构建紧凑联合空间邻域，并与共形预测或基于模型的规划集成。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出一种外部替代贝叶斯模型来量化黑盒视觉语言模型在视觉定位中的不确定性，以提高机器人在语言指导下的抓取鲁棒性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接面向视觉语言驱动的机器人操作任务，提升黑盒VLM在机器人视觉定位中的不确定性估计和主动交互能力，属于视觉语言动作（VLA）范畴。

papers.abstract: Video world models generate future visual observations from camera or action inputs, with the goal of synthesizing persistent 3D worlds that can be explored across time and space. Existing benchmarks typically evaluate short interactions or rely on camera trajectories fixed before generation. The performance of video world models under long-horizon exploration with extensive camera motion remains under-explored. We introduce WorldProbe, a diagnostic benchmark that uses a goal-conditioned multimodal agent to adapt camera actions online during generation. WorldProbe comprises 164 test cases across four probing families. Across 10 state-of-the-art models, we generate more than 1,600 rollouts totaling approximately 800 minutes, with horizons up to 180 seconds. Our evaluation across four dimensions reveals both the degradation of local measures and the emergence of long-range inconsistencies. We find that recent models sustain visual and content quality for longer, while long-range memory and evolution remain weak. These results expose a gap between locally stable generation and persistent world consistency that is largely missed by existing benchmarks. Code and benchmark resources are available at https://github.com/Untitled-W/WorldProbe.

analysis.key_results: 发现近期模型在视觉和内容质量上持续时间更长，但长程记忆和演化仍然薄弱，暴露出局部稳定生成与持久世界一致性之间的差距。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入WorldProbe基准，包含164个测试用例，利用目标条件多模态智能体在线调整相机动作，以诊断视频世界模型在长程探索中的表现。
analysis.method: 构建目标条件多模态智能体在线调整相机动作，在四个探测系列、164个测试用例中，对10个最先进模型生成超过1600条轨迹，评估四个维度。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出WorldProbe基准，通过目标条件多模态智能体在线调整相机动作来诊断视频世界模型在长程空间探索下的持久一致性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接针对视频世界模型（WAM）的持久一致性和长程探索能力进行基准测试，具有明确的机器人世界建模和评估价值，但未涉及VLA。

papers.title: WorldProbe: When Video World Models Fall Apart under Long-Horizon Spatial Exploration
papers.title_zh: WorldProbe：视频世界模型在长程空间探索中崩溃的诊断基准

papers.abstract: Interactive video world models aim to follow user actions while maintaining scene consistency over extended interactions. History-based methods reuse generated latents to preserve scene content, but three limitations of this reuse contribute to error recirculation. 1) The latent generated at each interaction is retained as history, potentially containing blurred details, geometric distortions, or semantic drift. 2) Although retrieved historical content matches the current scene, it can still contain errors that are carried into the next chunk. 3) New outputs then become history for later interactions, potentially reinforcing the same errors through repeated reuse. To limit this cycle, we aim to predict the future scene state from the current generated latent and the next action before generating the next interaction's video chunk. This future-state prior provides guidance for the next chunk, with the aim of reducing the errors carried forward from history. To this end, we propose a plug-and-play Causal Next-Chunk Predictor (C-NCP) with cross-model adaptability and prediction-guided modulation. We integrate C-NCP into four base generators and evaluate the augmented models across three benchmarks for interactive long-video generation and action-conditioned world modeling. Extensive experiments demonstrate reduced error accumulation and improved long-horizon consistency across diverse generation settings. The project page is at https://GuangYuanKK.github.io/futureworld.

analysis.key_results: 在三个基准上的多组实验表明，C-NCP能减少误差累积并提升长期一致性。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出即插即用的因果下一块预测器C-NCP，用于预测未来场景状态并指导下一块生成，以减少误差累积并提升长期一致性。
analysis.method: 使用因果下一块预测器C-NCP，通过当前生成隐状态和下一动作预测未来场景状态，并采用预测引导调制来指导下一块生成。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出即插即用的因果下一块预测器C-NCP，通过预测未来场景状态来减少交互式视频生成中的误差累积并提升长期一致性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作属于交互式视频世界模型，核心是动作条件下预测未来场景状态并改善长期一致性，与动作世界建模范式高度相关，对WAM研究有直接参考价值。

figures.caption: Improving long-horizon consistency through explicit next-state prediction. (a) Reusing generated history can carry existing errors into subsequent generations, allowing scene distortions and semantic drift to accumulate across interactions (red dashed boxes). (b) Our plug-in predictor estimates the next latent state from the current generated latent and the next action. This future-state prior guides the autoregressive video DiT through feature modulation, helping preserve scene structure and semantic consistency as interactions proceed (green dashed boxes).

Panel a presents the Causal Next-Chunk Predictor, which combines VAE-specific adapters, action conditioning, and a causal spatiotemporal backbone to predict the complete next latent chunk. Panel b illustrates next-chunk prediction training, where the predictor learns to forecast subsequent latent chunks from input chunks and control conditions under supervision from corresponding ground-truth chunks. papers.abstract: Reasoning informs decision-making by connecting intended actions with their expected consequences. Recent vision-language-action (VLA) models incorporate embodied chains of thought (ECoTs) to guide action generation. However, such guidance remains implicit, as actions are conditioned on ECoTs rather than explicitly optimized to align with them. We introduce CoRAct, a consequence-grounded reasoning-to-action alignment framework that explicitly aligns reasoning and action through reward-guided optimization in action noise space. CoRAct formulates two physically grounded ECoT components as verifiable signals: movement specifies intended motion, while waypoints encode expected spatial consequences. A unified Mixture-of-Transformers jointly models ECoT reasoning, action generation, and action-conditioned future prediction. For candidate actions generated from sampled noise, CoRAct computes alignment rewards based on movement consistency and agreement between predicted outcomes and specified waypoints. These rewards guide group-relative optimization of the initial noise distribution, steering action generation toward consistency with intended actions and expected consequences. Experiments across RoboCasa, VLABench, and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate improvements in task success, generalization, and reasoning-execution alignment over strong ECoT-based VLA baselines. CoRAct also grounds externally provided ECoTs in executable behavior, enabling zero-shot adaptation to novel scenarios by leveraging knowledge from powerful vision-language models. Project page and dataset: https://onlyxingxingzyx.github.io/CoRAct/

analysis.key_results: 在RoboCasa、VLABench和真实世界操作任务上的实验表明，与基于ECoT的VLA基线相比，任务成功率、泛化性和推理-执行对齐均有所改善；CoRAct还能将外部提供的ECoT落地为可执行行为，实现零样本适应新场景。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出CoRAct框架，通过基于后果的对齐方法，在动作噪声空间中显式对齐推理与动作，使用奖励引导优化初始噪声分布。
analysis.method: CoRAct使用统一的Mixture-of-Transformers联合建模ECoT推理、动作生成和动作条件下的未来预测；计算基于运动一致性和预测结果与指定路径点一致性的对齐奖励，引导噪声分布的组相对优化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: CoRAct通过奖励引导的优化在动作噪声空间中对齐推理与动作，提高VLA模型的任务成功率和泛化能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接聚焦于VLA模型，通过显式对齐推理与动作来提升策略性能，对机器人操作任务有直接贡献，与VLA主题高度相关。

figures.caption: Reasoning-to-action alignment paradigms. (a) Direct CoT-to-action learning leaves reasoning–execution correspondence implicit. (b) CoRAct explicitly bridges reasoning and execution through consequence-grounded optimization of the action noise distribution, aligning generated actions with articulated intent and expected outcomes.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: Framework of CoRAct. (a) CoRAct jointly models ECoT reasoning, action generation, and action-conditioned future prediction in a unified Mixture-of-Transformers, coupling actions with intent and consequence. (b) It then freezes the backbone and optimizes a conditional noise policy with movement and consequence rewards, steering action sampling toward better reasoning–execution alignment.

papers.title: From Reasoning to Action: Consequence-Grounded Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.title_zh: 从推理到行动：视觉-语言-行动模型的后果基对齐

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models excel at instruction following, yet most remain feed-forward: they condition actions only on the current observation and discard both long-horizon temporal context and the hierarchical structure of VLM representations. We present PRIME W0, a hierarchical conditional flow-matching framework that closes this gap through three synergistic designs: (1)per-layer KV injection from a pretrained VLM into an Adaptive MoE action expert; (2)dynamics-aware conditioning via asynchronous world-model subgoal-image prediction and a DINOv2 historical-frame semantic bridge; and (3)Action Dynamic Manifold (ADM) flow matching with covariance-structured noise that respects robot kinematic coupling. PRIME W0 is trained in four stages---VLM pre-training, DAT/NTP visuomotor pre-training, DiT flow-matching decoder assembly with WM injection, and end-to-end SFT---and achieves state-of-the-art results on LIBERO and real-robot benchmarks, with systematic ablations validating each architectural component.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO和真实机器人基准上取得最先进结果，并通过系统消融验证每个架构组件的有效性。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出PRIME W0，一种分层条件流匹配框架，通过三层协同设计：逐层VLM键值注入自适应MoE动作专家、动力学感知条件（异步世界模型子目标图像预测与DINOv2历史帧语义桥）、以及协方差结构化噪声的动作动力学流匹配，并在LIBERO和真实机器人基准上取得最优结果。
analysis.method: 分层条件流匹配框架，包含：1）从预训练VLM逐层注入KV到自适应MoE动作专家；2）动力学感知条件：异步世界模型子目标图像预测和DINOv2历史帧语义桥；3）动作动力学流匹配：协方差结构化噪声尊重机器人运动学耦合。训练分为四阶段：VLM预训练、DAT/NTP视觉运动预训练、带世界模型注入的DiT流匹配解码器组装、端到端SFT。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出PRIME W0，一种分层条件流匹配框架，通过注入视觉语言模型特征、异步世界模型子目标预测和动作动力学流匹配，提升具身操作性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文核心是VLA模型，直接融合世界模型进行子目标预测和动力学感知条件，属于VLA与世界模型深度结合的工作，对本站主题高度相关。

figures.caption: Four-stage training pipeline. (1) VLM Pretrain: the vision–language backbone is trained on general multimodal supervision (e.g. captioning / VQA). (2) NTP / task-specific pre-training: with DAT action tokens, the VLM learns visuomotor next-token prediction over instruction–observation–action sequences. (3) DiT Pretrain: the VLM is frozen while the MoT / Adaptive MoE flow-matching action expert is trained with world-model conditioning to denoise continuous actions (and associated state tokens). (4) SFT: both the VLM and the action expert are jointly fine-tuned end-to-end, optionally with action-prefix tokens that shorten the denoising trajectory at inference. papers.abstract: Imitation learning has become a widely adopted approach for vision-based robot policies, owing to its conceptual simplicity, scalability, and ability to leverage large-scale datasets. As these policies have grown more capable, action chunking has become their standard interface. At each decision step the policy outputs several future actions at once. Backbones from diffusion policies to large vision-language-action models all share it. Whatever backbone produces the chunk, its temporal structure is learned only implicitly. The commanded trajectory is therefore jerky both within a chunk and between successive chunks. On real hardware this appears as visible vibration and as repeated saturation of the follower's velocity limit. We address this issue by incorporating a movement-primitive-based trajectory representation into action chunking. Specifically, a trajectory segment is represented as a linear combination of smooth basis functions, yielding smooth trajectories by construction while leaving the policy architecture, training objective, and inference procedure unchanged. The same representation also yields a closed-form, inference-time correction for the second source of jerk. We condition the predicted coefficients so that the new chunk passes through a via-point at the previous chunk's last commanded action. This correction needs no retraining and, unlike asynchronous Real-Time Chunking, applies to policies queried in one shot. We instantiate it on a one-shot (ACT) and an iterative (DiT) backbone and evaluate in simulation and on a real bimanual ALOHA platform. The representation lowers within-chunk jerk by an order of magnitude on the one-shot backbone and by 2.4 times on the iterative one, with task success statistically non-inferior. The conditioning then removes 73-84% of the boundary discontinuity, at negligible per-step cost.

analysis.key_results: 在一次性骨干（ACT）上分块内抖动降低一个数量级，在迭代骨干（DiT）上降低2.4倍，任务成功率统计非劣；边界不连续消除73–84%，每步开销可忽略。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出将运动基元表示融入动作分块，使输出轨迹天然平滑，并给出闭环推理时校正以减少分块边界不连续，无需重训练且保持策略架构、训练目标和推理流程不变。
analysis.method: 将轨迹段表示为光滑基函数的线性组合；同时通过条件化预测系数使新分块经过上一分块最后命令动作的经由点，实现推理时校正。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出用运动基元的平滑基函数表示动作分块，消除视觉机器人策略输出轨迹的抖动，并在ACT和DiT骨干上验证了平滑性提升。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接面向视觉语言动作模型（VLA）常用的动作分块接口，解决真实机器人执行时的轨迹抖动和速度饱和问题；对VLA策略的输出动作表示和推理平滑性具有直接应用价值，但不涉及世界模型（WAM）。

papers.abstract: Giving embodied agents the freedom to act autonomously, initiate interactions, and understand their surroundings through experience is a step toward bringing them to life in the physical world. Realizing this vision requires action, interaction, and memory to work together, so that each encounter can inform current decisions and contribute experience for future tasks. We present EvoLife, a unified navigation harness that enables a multimodal embodied agent to choose how to move, when to ask, and what experience to carry forward. Its hybrid action space supports waypoint navigation, local discrete adjustments, pixel-based navigation, and object-directed navigation. Active interaction allows the agent to seek clarification or assistance when it encounters ambiguity or difficulty, while persistent spatial memory binds observations and dialogue to places, retaining useful experience to guide subsequent visits. We evaluate eight benchmarks across four task families: vision-language navigation, object navigation, interactive instance navigation, and continuous multi-task navigation. With an average of only 1.87 active interactions per episode, our method achieves a first-visit success rate (SR) of 100% across four 100-episode sets spanning vision-language navigation and object navigation. Complete-sequence SR reaches 98% on 50 LHPR-VLN sequences and 94% on 50 GOAT-Bench sequences. In the R2R revisit setting, success weighted by path length (SPL) increases from 82.23% to 93.31% with retained experience. Multi-day physical navigation further demonstrates exploration, proactive help-seeking, and revisiting remembered places. Together, these results advance the vision of bringing embodied agents to life through autonomous action, proactive interaction, and the accumulation and reuse of experience.

analysis.key_results: 在四个100回合集合上，平均主动交互仅1.87次，首次访问成功率达100%；在50个LHPR-VLN序列上完整序列成功率达98%，在50个GOAT-Bench序列上达94%；R2R重访设置中，带经验重用SPL从82.23%提升至93.31%；多日物理导航验证了探索、主动求助和重访记忆地点的能力。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出统一导航框架EvoLife，集成混合动作空间、主动交互和持久空间记忆，使智能体能够在多个导航任务中积累并重用经验，实现终身导航。
analysis.method: EvoLife框架结合混合动作空间（航点导航、局部离散调整、基于像素的导航、物体导向导航）、主动交互（在遇到歧义或困难时寻求澄清或帮助）以及持久空间记忆（将观察和对话绑定到地点并保留有用经验）。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出统一导航框架EvoLife，使多模态具身智能体通过混合动作空间、主动交互和持久空间记忆，在多种导航任务中实现终身学习与高成功率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作属于具身视觉-语言-动作（VLA）框架，强调多模态输入下的动作选择与记忆机制，对本站VLA研究具有直接相关性，但未涉及世界模型（WAM）或推理加速技术。

papers.abstract: Linear recurrences are emerging as practical alternatives to softmax attention in large language models, appearing in both standalone and hybrid architectures. However, despite their rapid emergence, low-precision inference remains much less developed for these models than for softmax attention. During prefill, chunkwise-parallel algorithms cast much of the recurrence as dense matrix multiplications, suggesting a natural path to low-precision execution. Simply quantizing these operations in their native form, however, can be fragile. In this work, we identify functional invariances that preserve the full-precision computation while making the operands more amenable to quantization. Building on this observation, we introduce LinQuant, a framework for low-precision recurrent prefill based on seven such invariances, including rotations, diagonal rescalings, and alternative placements of recurrent decay and write factors. We derive when these transformations remain valid across common recurrence families spanning linear, gated, and delta-rule updates, and show that they provide complementary degrees of freedom for improving low-precision accuracy. Finally, we translate this framework to production by augmenting SSDi8, an existing low-precision prefill pipeline for Mamba-2, with the applicable invariances. LinQuant improves perplexity at matched latency on Mamba-2 1.3B, 2.7B, and 8B and Nemotron-H 8B, demonstrating the practical utility of invariance-based quantization for recurrent models.

analysis.key_results: 在Mamba-2 1.3B、2.7B、8B和Nemotron-H 8B模型上，LinQuant在匹配延迟下改善了困惑度。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出LinQuant框架，利用七种功能不变性（如旋转、对角缩放、递归衰减和写入因子的替代放置）来改进低精度循环预填充的量化效果。
analysis.method: 基于功能不变性的量化框架LinQuant，应用于常见的线性、门控和delta-rule递归族，并结合SSDi8流水线进行实验。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: LinQuant利用线性递归模型中的功能不变性来改善低精度推理的准确性，并通过实验验证其在Mamba-2和Nemotron-H上的效果。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 无直接关系。本文专注于循环神经网络的低精度量化，未涉及VLA、WAM或机器人应用。

papers.abstract: Predicting where to grasp and how to move is fundamentally a geometry problem. Vision-language models treat it as language generation instead. They tokenize spatial coordinates into text and decode them autoregressively. This mechanism ignores spatial structure and truncates continuous precision. Errors compound across coordinate tokens during decoding. In this paper, we show that compact off-the-shelf VLMs with 0.5-2B parameters already encode rich spatial information in their intermediate hidden states. Autoregressive decoding is the dominant bottleneck for trajectory prediction, while affordance prediction depends additionally on feature depth and decoder architecture. We expose the latent spatial information with a lightweight, geometry-compatible prediction head that attaches to a frozen backbone. It reads features from an intermediate hidden layer, conditions a learned query on the task instruction and refines it via cross-attention over the visual tokens to regress affordance boxes and trajectory waypoints directly as continuous values, without modifying the backbone. We evaluate on ShareRobot-Bench and AGD20K. Our 2B variant reduces trajectory error by over 60% and improves ShareRobot-Bench affordance mAP by 85% relative to the autoregressive baseline. It approaches RoboBrain on trajectory prediction (0.251 vs 0.191 DFD) at 3.8x higher throughput. These results demonstrate a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off for instruction-conditioned 2D geometric prediction.

analysis.key_results: 2B模型轨迹误差降低60%以上，ShareRobot-Bench可供性mAP相对自回归基线提升85%，轨迹预测DFD达到0.251（接近RoboBrain的0.191），吞吐量提高3.8倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出轻量级、几何兼容的预测头，附着于冻结的小型VLM骨干网络上，直接从中间层特征回归可供性框和轨迹路径点，无需自回归解码，在显著提升精度的同时降低计算开销。
analysis.method: 冻结0.5-2B参数的VLM骨干网络，使用附加的轻量预测头，从中间隐藏层读取特征，通过任务指令条件化学习查询，并跨视觉令牌进行交叉注意力，直接回归连续几何输出。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文证明小型视觉语言模型通过连续几何回归代替自回归令牌解码，可显著提升机器人可供性与轨迹预测的精度和效率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接改进机器人视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的推理效率和精度，用连续几何回归替代自回归解码，对机器人操作中的可供性预测和轨迹生成具有直接应用价值。

figures.caption: Architecture overview. A frozen VLM processes an RGB image and task instruction; hidden states from an intermediate layer are passed to a lightweight geometric prediction head. A DETR-style transformer decoder, conditioned on the instruction via the final text token hidden state, refines a learned query against the visual memory tokens. Two independent FFNs decode the query into continuous outputs: affordance boxes (L1+GIoU loss) and trajectory waypoints (L1+startpoint+endpoint loss). No gradient flows into the VLM.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.title: Decoding Geometry, Not Tokens: Efficient VLMs for Robot Affordance and Trajectory Prediction

papers.abstract: Human cognition flexibly draws on a shared perceptual foundation to understand environments, attend to referenced entities, reason about spatial relationships, and act. Endowing aerial robots with an analogous functional organization remains challenging, as existing systems are often specialized for individual capabilities, dependent on offboard computation, or unable to sustain closed-loop operation on resource-constrained platforms. We present OpenFlyV2, a unified onboard vision-language-action architecture that uses a shared vision-language representation to support semantic understanding, language-grounded perception, spatial reasoning, and continuous aerial control within a single model. A compact action expert converts the shared multimodal context into short-horizon flight waypoints, while motion-aware temporal memory and action priors reduce the computational cost of closed-loop execution. We construct \dataset{}, a simulation-based dataset comprising approximately 70,000 navigation trajectories and 60,000 vision-language instruction--response pairs. OpenFlyV2 generates action chunks, each comprising 12 waypoints, entirely onboard at 10 Hz using an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX. It transfers zero-shot from simulation to physical quadrotor flight, achieving a 48\% navigation success rate across four real-world environments without real-world aerial training data. Extensive results demonstrate that broad vision-language competence and continuous closed-loop flight can coexist within a single model on a resource-constrained aerial platform. Code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/Ideal-ljl/AeroBrain.

analysis.key_results: 在模拟中训练后，零样本迁移到真实四旋翼飞行，在四个真实世界环境中达到 48% 的导航成功率，无需真实世界空中训练数据；在资源受限平台上展示了单一模型同时具备广泛的视觉-语言能力和连续闭环飞行。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出并验证了 OpenFlyV2，一个统一的机载视觉-语言-动作模型，在单一模型中整合语义理解、语言引导感知、空间推理和连续飞行控制，并构建了包含约 70,000 条导航轨迹和 60,000 对视觉-语言指令-响应的模拟数据集。
analysis.method: 使用共享视觉-语言表示，通过紧凑动作专家将多模态上下文转换为短时飞行航点；引入运动感知时间记忆和动作先验以降低闭环执行的计算成本；生成包含 12 个航点的动作块，在 NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 上以 10 Hz 完全机载运行。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: OpenFlyV2 是一种统一的机载视觉-语言-动作架构，在资源受限平台上以单一模型支持语义理解、语言引导感知、空间推理和连续空中控制。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文是典型的 VLA 工作，将视觉-语言表示与动作预测紧密结合，用于空中机器人导航和操控；其动作块生成与闭环机载执行展示了在资源受限机器人上的高效推理，与 VLA 主题高度相关，但不涉及世界模型或高效推理优化。

papers.abstract: Predicting future physical states stands as a central challenge in embodied intelligence. Existing video world models leave 3D dynamics implicit, action-based formulations remain tied to specific robot configurations, and 3D motion prediction models use flow-only supervision, providing a limited learning signal for physical dynamics. To circumvent these limitations, we introduce \method{}, a generative world model that jointly predicts future video and query-based 3D trajectories. By parameterizing 3D motion as continuous displacement tokens aligned with the video grid, a unified Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) backbone jointly denoises both modalities under a rectified-flow objective. This formulation couples explicit geometric dynamics with visual evolution, effectively unlocking the physical commonsense embedded within pretrained video models. To empirically scale and validate this unified architecture, we train \method{} on a heterogeneous mixture of 1.44 million object-level samples spanning simulated and real-world domains. We further introduce WorldFlowBench, comprising 1,678 evaluation samples from 11 data sources across simulated and real-world interactions, including spatial reasoning tasks. Across all three evaluation sets, WorldFlow achieves the lowest average displacement error (ADE) and final displacement error (FDE) among the evaluated learning-based methods. Notably, on the challenging SpatialCog set, WorldFlow achieves an ADE of 0.060 m, a 54.2\% reduction compared with the strongest external baseline. It also reduces ADE and FDE by 55.9\% and 68.5\%, respectively, compared with its flow-only variant. Project page: https://worldflow-rbs.github.io/.

analysis.key_results: 在三个评估集上WorldFlow取得最低平均位移误差（ADE）和最终位移误差（FDE）；在SpatialCog集上ADE降低54.2%，相较其仅流变体ADE与FDE分别降低55.9%和68.5%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出WorldFlow生成式世界模型，联合预测未来视频和查询主导的3D轨迹，打破现有视频世界模型、动作基元模型和3D运动预测模型的局限。
analysis.method: 将3D运动参数化为与视频网格对齐的连续位移令牌，使用统一混合Transformer（MoT）骨干网络在整流流目标下联合去噪两种模态。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: WorldFlow提出一个生成式世界模型，联合预测未来视频和查询驱动的3D轨迹，通过统一Transformer架构和整流流目标在144万样本上预训练。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文属于机器人世界模型方向，显式预测3D几何动态与视觉演化，为VLA和WAM提供可扩展的物理动力学学习基础，与本站主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: While frontier vision-language models demonstrate strong capabilities in user interface (UI) navigation, their high inference costs prohibit everyday use. Conversely, smaller models trained via supervised fine-tuning (SFT) or offline reinforcement learning often memorize static trajectories, leading to brittle execution and an inability to recover from errors. To address these limitations, we propose a novel online reinforcement learning framework that trains UI navigation agents directly on live iOS applications. Our framework decouples the agent into two specialized components: a Planning agent and a UI Grounding model. We rely on an LLM-as-a-Judge to provide comprehensive reward signals, combining dense, step-level feedback to evaluate intermediate progress with a terminal reward for overall task completion. To effectively leverage this dual reward structure, we optimize the agent using Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) with step-level advantage estimation. Furthermore, we introduce GiGPPO, a novel neighbor-conditioned value estimation method that improves critic stability by leveraging reward signals from visually similar states across concurrent trajectories. To support this online training paradigm at scale, we introduce an efficient infrastructure that orchestrates hundreds of concurrent virtual iOS devices. Evaluations on rigorous benchmarks, including UINavBench, iOSWorld, and AndroidWorld, demonstrate that our online RL trained agents substantially outperform both SFT and terminal-only RL baselines while accelerating training convergence. Notably, our 8B RL agents achieve nearly a sevenfold improvement over the SFT baseline in out-of-distribution generalization to Android environments, while outperforming Gemini-3.5-Flash and tying with Gemini-3.1-Pro on real iOS applications.

analysis.key_results: 在UINavBench、iOSWorld和AndroidWorld基准上，在线RL智能体显著优于SFT和仅终端奖励的RL基线，在向Android环境泛化时8B模型相对SFT提升近七倍，并在真实iOS应用上优于Gemini-3.5-Flash。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种将智能体解耦为规划智能体和UI接地模型的在线强化学习框架，并引入基于LLM-as-a-Judge的密集奖励和GiGPPO值估计方法，以提升UI导航性能。
analysis.method: 采用在线强化学习，将智能体拆分为规划智能体和UI接地模型，使用LLM-as-a-Judge提供密集步骤级奖励和任务完成奖励，通过PPO与逐步优势估计优化，并引入GiGPPO邻居条件值估计。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出一种在线强化学习框架，通过分离规划与UI接地模型，在实时iOS应用上训练UI导航智能体。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文聚焦于UI导航智能体的在线强化学习框架，与VLA/WAM无直接关系，但其降低推理成本的动机可能为高效推理模型提供借鉴。

figures.caption: Example traces of the GiGPPO-trained planning agent and the SFT baseline on the UINavBench task: ”Find a route from Apple Park to the Santa Clara Caltrain Station.” Pink crosshairs indicate the agent’s tap and text-entry actions at each step. Because the Apple Maps workflow requires selecting the destination before the starting location, the agents are easily confused by the task prompt’s phrasing, which mentions the starting point first. The GiGPPO agent initially sets the destination as Apple Park, but it corrects itself by exiting the directions search and restarting with the Santa Clara Caltrain Station as the destination, demonstrating strong error recovery. papers.abstract: Embodied world models should not only imagine plausible futures, but also perceive the geometric, semantic, and motion structure of the evolving world. We present GenSight, a unified embodied world model that brings future video generation and dense perception into a single pretrained video diffusion transformer. GenSight uses a unified spatiotemporal representation for video, depth, embodiment segmentation, and first-frame-relative 2D flow. Built on a shared DiT backbone, GenSight uses lightweight task modulation to predict all modalities within the same architecture. All tasks are jointly optimized within a unified velocity prediction space. At inference, GenSight supports two complementary modes: multi-step future video generation with aligned dense predictions and single-step dense perception from an observed video. By unifying modality representation, model architecture, and prediction space, GenSight avoids separate modality-specific pipelines and couples appearance, geometry, semantics, and motion in a shared representation. It promotes cross-modal consistency and allows dense perception to benefit from the spatiotemporal priors learned through video generation. Trained on embodied manipulation data spanning multiple robot embodiments and human-hand interactions, GenSight demonstrates strong performance in both video generation and dense 4D perception, highlighting the effectiveness of unifying seeing and imagining for embodied world modeling.

analysis.key_results: 在具身操作数据上训练后，GenSight 在视频生成和稠密四维感知上均表现优异，展示了统一“看”与“想像”的有效性。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 GenSight，用统一时空表示、共享 DiT 骨干、轻量任务调制及统一速度预测空间，在同架构内联合优化视频、深度、实施例分割和第一帧相对三维流，避免多模态分离流程并促进跨模态一致性。
analysis.method: 统一表示（视频、深度、实施例分割、第一帧相对三维流）、共享 DiT 骨干、轻量任务调制、统一速度预测空间、两步推理（多步未来视频生成带对齐稠密预测、单步稠密感知）及多机器人实施例与人类手交互数据的联合训练。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: GenSight 提出一个统一的具身世界模型，将未来视频生成与稠密四维感知集成到单个预训练视频扩散 Transformer 中。
