papers.abstract: Vision--Language--Action (VLA) models generate robot actions from visual observations and language instructions, but their understanding of physical dynamics remains limited. Video world models can capture scene dynamics, yet generating future videos introduces high latency into the control loop. We introduce PDRVLA, whose lightweight Physical Dynamics Module extracts physical tokens from vision--language features to condition action generation without online video generation. The module learns through direct prediction of future RGB, depth, and optical-flow features, with auxiliary supervision through a frozen pretrained video world model. Training relies entirely on publicly available data, expanded through human-to-robot synthesis, subtask annotation, and embodied chain-of-thought (ECoT) annotation. Across four simulation benchmarks, PDRVLA achieves success rates of 99.3% on LIBERO, 89.9% on LIBERO-Plus, 93.6% on RoboTwin~2.0, and 81.5% on SimplerEnv. Ablations show improved future prediction with world-model supervision and evaluate how subtask conditioning, future object-pose supervision, and ECoT training affect action success.

analysis.key_results: 在四个仿真基准上取得成功率：LIBERO 99.3%，LIBERO-Plus 89.9%，RoboTwin 2.0 93.6%，SimplerEnv 81.5%；消融实验表明世界模型监督改善未来预测，并评估了子任务条件、未来物体姿态监督和 ECoT 训练的影响。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 PDRVLA，在 VLA 中引入轻量物理动力学模块，利用未来 RGB、深度和光流特征预测及冻结视频世界模型监督，增强物理理解，而无需在控制回路中进行视频生成。
analysis.method: 从视觉-语言特征中提取物理 token，直接预测未来 RGB、深度和光流特征，通过冻结的预训练视频世界模型提供辅助监督；训练数据结合人-机器人合成、子任务标注和具身思维链（ECoT）扩展。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: PDRVLA 通过轻量物理动力学模块将未来视觉特征预测蒸馏到 VLA 模型中，避免在线视频生成延迟，提升机器人动作生成性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接属于 VLA 模型范畴，融合视频世界模型知识以增强物理动力学表征，但不进行在线视频生成，与机器人世界模型（WAM）密切相关。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models integrate high-level reasoning with low-level action execution for end-to-end robotic control. However, most VLA models target static manipulation in unconstrained environments, overlooking spatial constraints and dynamic obstacles. Fine-tuning VLAs on obstacle-avoidance data is a straightforward solution, but collecting such data is costly, especially for dynamic scenarios, and may degrade their original task capabilities. To address these limitations, we propose VLA-Stem, a lightweight, reinforcement-learning-based safety mechanism for VLA systems. Without fine-tuning the underlying VLA policy, VLA-Stem converts its action chunks into motion references and uses trajectory-level guidance to preserve their spatial intent while allowing flexible motion and timing adjustments. Conditioned on these references, robot proprioception, and local obstacle information, the Stem policy adaptively modifies execution at inference time, preserving the original task intent while enabling responsive adaptation to spatial constraints and dynamic obstacles. For robust and sample-efficient training, we combine teacher-student distillation with curriculum learning. We evaluate VLA-Stem on reference following, static spatial constraints, and dynamic obstacle avoidance. Across six constrained simulation settings, VLA-Stem achieves 52.8% average collision-free task success versus 23.7% for the strongest safety baseline, while preserving base-policy performance in obstacle-free settings; real-world experiments further show consistent collision reductions under static and dynamic obstacles. These results demonstrate that VLA-Stem couples high-level VLA task intent with rapid, reflex-like responses to immediate physical risks, providing a brainstem-inspired mechanism for robust robot execution.

analysis.key_results: 在六个受限仿真环境中，VLA-Stem平均无碰撞任务成功率为52.8%，最强安全基线为23.7%；在无障碍设置中保持基础策略性能；真实实验显示在静态和动态障碍下碰撞显著减少。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出VLA-Stem：一种轻量级、基于强化学习的安全机制，无需微调VLA策略即可在推理时对动作进行自适应修改，以应对空间约束和动态障碍，同时保留任务意图。
analysis.method: 将VLA动作块转换为运动参考，使用轨迹级引导保留空间意图；结合教师-学生蒸馏和课程学习训练Stem策略；推理时基于参考、机器人本体感知和局部障碍信息修改执行动作。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出VLA-Stem，一种无需微调底层VLA策略的轻量级强化学习安全机制，在推理时自适应修改动作以处理空间约束和动态障碍。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接针对VLA模型在动态和受限环境中的鲁棒执行问题，提出了一种无需微调的安全机制，对VLA在真实世界部署和与动作执行层结合具有直接价值。

In this functional analogy, higher-level task control and motor coordination correspond to the base VLA, while the brainstem-inspired lower-level regulation corresponds to our proposed VLA-Stem . Finally, the teacher policy is used to distill a student policy, removing the dependence on task-specific privileged information at deployment.

papers.abstract: We present EmbeddingGemma 2, an open multimodal embedding model which natively represents text, images, audio, video, and combinations thereof in a unified space. Our approach introduces improvements such as simplified per-layer embeddings and a multi-stage curriculum with modality and objective progression which ensure strong quality across unimodal, cross-modal, and mixed-modal evaluations. Notably, in comprehensive embedding benchmarks across all modalities, EmbeddingGemma 2 establishes a new Pareto frontier, outperforming both specialist models and models two to twelve times larger. Furthermore, our design offers flexibility for resource-constrained environments, supporting selective modality encoder loading, adjustable vision token budgets, truncatable embedding dimensions, and quantized weights. We present ablations analyzing key decisions and release EmbeddingGemma 2 to promote further research.

analysis.key_results: 在涵盖所有模态的综合嵌入基准上，EmbeddingGemma 2 建立了新的帕累托前沿，优于专用模型以及大2到12倍的模型。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了 EmbeddingGemma 2，一个开源的多模态嵌入模型，统一表示文本、图像、音频、视频及其组合，并通过简化的逐层嵌入、多阶段课程学习以及灵活的效率设计（如选择性模态编码器加载、可调视觉令牌预算、截断嵌入维度、量化权重）取得了全面的质量与效率平衡。
analysis.method: 简化逐层嵌入；多阶段课程与模态及目标递进；选择性模态编码器加载；可调视觉令牌预算；截断嵌入维度；量化权重。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种统一的多模态嵌入模型 EmbeddingGemma 2，通过多项效率设计（如量化权重）在多种模态基准上达到新的帕累托前沿。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作聚焦多模态嵌入的效率优化，其中量化权重与可调视觉令牌预算等方法对在资源受限环境下部署 VLA 或世界模型具有借鉴意义，但摘要未直接涉及机器人动作预测或世界建模。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide a promising paradigm for scalable robotic manipulation, yet their reliance on success-only behavioral cloning leaves them brittle; lacking corrective training signals, minor execution errors rapidly compound into unrecoverable, out-of-distribution failures. To address this limitation, we propose Adaptive Failure-Informed Learning (AFIL), an end-to-end framework that leverages failure trajectories as adaptive negative guidance for diffusion- and flow-based VLA policies. AFIL uses a pretrained VLA to generate failure rollouts online, avoiding the need for handcrafted failure-mode design or human-in-the-loop recovery. It then jointly trains Dual Action Generators (DAGs) for successful and failed behaviors while sharing a common vision-language backbone, enabling efficient failure-aware policy learning with limited parameter overhead. During sampling, the failure generator adaptively steers action generation away from failure-prone regions and toward more reliable success modes, with guidance strength determined by the per-diffusion-step distance between success and failure distributions. Experiments across in-domain and out-of-domain robotic manipulation tasks, covering both short- and long-horizon settings, show that AFIL consistently improves task success rates and robustness over existing VLA baselines, demonstrating its effectiveness, efficiency, and generality.

analysis.key_results: 在域内外、短视距和长视距机器人操作任务上，AFIL在任务成功率和鲁棒性上均优于现有VLA基线。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出AFIL框架，利用失败轨迹作为自适应负向引导，以提升扩散和流基VLA策略的性能。
analysis.method: AFIL使用预训练VLA在线生成失败rollout，联合训练双动作生成器（成功与失败），共享视觉语言骨干，并在采样时根据成功与失败分布的距离自适应调整动作生成。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出自适应失败知情学习框架AFIL，通过在线生成失败轨迹并联合训练成功与失败动作生成器来提升VLA策略的鲁棒性和任务成功率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文直接针对VLA策略在机器人操作中的鲁棒性问题，提出利用失败轨迹的在线学习框架，属于VLA策略学习核心方向。

papers.abstract: Proprietary language models and their reasoning traces are vulnerable to API-based distillation, where an adversary trains a student model on the teacher model's outputs. To obtain evidence of distillation, model providers can watermark the teacher's outputs, aiming to leave a radioactive signal in the student's outputs. Existing black-box detectors search for such radioactivity using token-level statistics of the suspect model's outputs. However, token-level signals are not always detectable, for instance when the distillation traces are sampled at a low temperature. In this work, we discover the watermark basin, a persistent signal that enables more reliable watermark detection: during fine-tuning, watermarked teacher traces embed a distinct, key-specific geometric signal in parameter space that lies orthogonal to the ordinary task-specific fine-tuning subspace. Building on this, we introduce Watermark Basin Alignment (WM-Basin), a black-box watermark detector that queries the suspect model through its API, without access to its weights or logits. WM-Basin maps generated text to gradient representations using a fixed clean probe model, projects out the ordinary fine-tuning task directions, and tests whether the residual gradient aligns with the watermark basin induced by the watermark key. We evaluate WM-Basin extensively across diverse teacher models and student architectures (from 135M to 8.2B parameters) distilled on mathematical reasoning. At a strict 0.1% false-positive rate, WM-Basin detects 79% of distilled models at n-gram=1 and 45% at n-gram=3, substantially improving over the state-of-the-art token-level baseline (29% and 1.3%, respectively). Because the watermark signal resides in a persistent basin, it survives post-distillation modifications including quantization, pruning, and reinforcement-learning post-training.

analysis.key_results: 在 0.1% 假阳性率下，n-gram=1 时检测到 79% 的蒸馏模型，n-gram=3 时为 45%，显著优于 token-level 基线（分别为 29% 和 1.3%）；水印信号在量化、剪枝和强化学习后训练后仍可存活。
analysis.main_contribution: 发现水印盆地这一持久信号，并基于此提出黑盒检测器 WM-Basin，无需访问模型权重或 logits 即可检测 API 蒸馏。
analysis.method: 利用固定干净探针模型将文本映射为梯度表示，投影出普通微调任务方向，并检验残差梯度与水印盆地是否对齐。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出一种黑盒水印检测方法，通过探测模型输出的梯度表示与特定水印盆地对齐来识别被蒸馏的学生模型。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文不涉及 VLA 或 WAM，属于独立的大语言模型安全与检测工作；但其提出的黑盒检测框架可能对高效推理（如量化、剪枝等模型压缩手段）下的水印保留问题有借鉴价值。

figures.caption: The watermark basin. Training on watermarked traces moves the student into a persistent, key-specific watermark basin , whereas clean traces from the same teacher move it only along the task direction. Watermark Basin Alignment ( WM-Basin ) recovers this geometry from black-box outputs alone to detect distillation.
figures.label: Figure 1

papers.title: Watermark Basins: Black-Box Detection of Distilled LLMs

papers.abstract: Recent advances in interactive world models have made it possible to generate controllable, dynamic environments from action inputs. Yet current models struggle to maintain coherence beyond roughly one minute of rollout, a limitation rooted not in model capacity but in the scarcity of long-horizon training data. Existing gameplay video datasets typically consist of clips under ten seconds, with captions that describe whole clips in coarse and undifferentiated text, which is insufficient for controllable long-horizon generation. We address this with GameVerse, a minute-scale gameplay video dataset purpose-built for long-horizon interactive world modeling. GameVerse contains 69.7K clips spanning 1,655 hours and 349.6 million frames across diverse first- and third-person gameplay, including 1,358 hours of continuous two-minute sequences, an order of magnitude longer than prior datasets. Clips pass through a unified pipeline of scene-consistent segmentation, quality filtering, camera pose estimation, and event-based caption annotation. Each clip is paired with a temporally stable camera trajectory that remains coherent across minutes, together with captions that separate static scene context from dynamic foreground events and align to event boundaries rather than fixed time windows. Comprehensive analysis shows that GameVerse surpasses existing public datasets in scale, diversity, and annotation quality. Experiments further demonstrate that training on GameVerse substantially extends the temporal horizon of interactive world models.

analysis.key_results: GameVerse在规模、多样性和标注质量上超越现有公开数据集；实验表明在其上训练可显著扩展交互式世界模型的时间范围。
analysis.main_contribution: 构建了GameVerse数据集，包含69.7K个片段、1655小时、349.6M帧，其中连续两分钟序列达到1358小时，远超现有数据集。
analysis.method: 通过场景一致分割、质量过滤、相机姿态估计和基于事件边界的字幕标注流程，为每个片段生成时间稳定的相机轨迹及分离静态场景与动态事件的字幕。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: GameVerse是一个包含1655小时、平均2分钟长游戏视频的大规模数据集，旨在支持长时程交互式世界模型训练。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该数据集直接服务于交互式世界模型（WAM），提供长时程视频和动作条件，可为机器人世界建模提供数据支撑，但未涉及VLA或机器人操作。

papers.abstract: The vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action model (WAM) communities debate whether control policies should inherit pretrained knowledge from vision-language models or from visual generators. The debate, however, bundles three separable choices: backbone initialization, the objective applied to future observations, and whether the machinery for that future loss is kept at inference. A gap between a VLA and a WAM therefore cannot simply be attributed to any one of them. We show that decoupling these choices yields a common framework for both families, which we term Just Action Model (JAM): a pretrained visual backbone with an action expert, trained with an action loss and a foresight loss. The foresight loss trains current-observation features to predict frozen encodings of the recorded future through a prediction head discarded after training, so no visual generation is involved in either training or inference, and the backbone can be chosen freely. We first compare objectives within fixed policy architectures, then evaluate the foresight recipe across backbone families. The resulting JAM policies outperform their matched FastWAM and ImageWAM counterparts on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus, and achieve similar or slightly higher success rates on RoboTwin. Compared with FastWAM, JAM improves the success rates from 97.0%/55.3%/91.2% to 98.2%/64.5%/91.4%, respectively. With cached foresight targets, JAM reduces estimated online training FLOPs per sample per update by 73% relative to FastWAM. Our results show that future supervision improves control without visual generation or additional inference machinery, and strong foresight performance is attainable with either generator-initialized or vision-language backbones. Project Page: https://y0uroy.github.io/JAM

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO和LIBERO-Plus上超越匹配的FastWAM和ImageWAM，在RoboTwin上达到相似或略高的成功率；与FastWAM相比，JAM将成功率从97.0%/55.3%/91.2%提升到98.2%/64.5%/91.4%；使用缓存foresight目标，JAM将每个样本每次更新的估计在线训练FLOPs降低73%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Just Action Model（JAM）统一框架，将VLA与WAM的差异分解为骨干初始化、应用于未来观测的目标以及推断时是否需要维护未来损失机制，并证明仅通过训练时未来监督（foresight loss）即可提升控制性能，无需视觉生成或额外推断模块。
analysis.method: JAM采用预训练视觉骨干加动作专家，联合动作损失与foresight损失训练；foresight损失通过一个训练后丢弃的预测头，用当前观测特征预测已记录未来的冻结编码。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出统一框架JAM，将VLA与WAM解耦为骨干初始化、未来观测目标和推断时未来损失机制三个可分离选择，并通过训练时仅用未来预测头、推断时丢弃的方式提升控制性能并降低计算开销。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接面向VLA与WAM的整合，核心贡献是统一策略学习框架，通过解耦未来预测损失与推断时生成机制，在保持世界模型监督优势的同时消除推断开销，对机器人动作预测和世界建模具有直接的理论与实践价值。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies demonstrate remarkable semantic generalization, yet remain highly vulnerable to out-of-distribution (OOD) visual shifts during execution. While existing test-time methods attempt to suppress spurious visual cues, they fundamentally overlook the rich, uncorrupted kinematic priors embedded in the policy's own training experience. We introduce Retrieve to Act (R2A), a test-time scaling framework that formulates OOD robustness purely as a geometric motion primitive retrieval problem. R2A bypasses fragile visual features by structuring successful training demonstrations into an offline spatiotemporal motion primitive graph. During inference, a query-dependent Graph Neural Network dynamically localizes the robot's ongoing execution within this graph, retrieving structurally compatible future motion primitives. These retrieved geometric priors are then seamlessly harmonized with the frozen VLA's predicted actions via a learned, dimension-wise gating mechanism, adaptively rectifying erroneous spatial trajectories while preserving the policy's local reactivity. Extensive experiments across three state-of-the-art VLA architectures, GR00T N1.7, $\pi_{0.5}$, and StableVLA, demonstrate that R2A consistently and significantly enhances robustness against diverse contextual perturbations. R2A achieves absolute success rate improvements of up to +12% in simulation benchmarks (LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin2.0-Plus) and +40% in real-world deployments, without requiring any finetuning of the base policies. Project page: https://retrieve2act.github.io/r2a/

analysis.key_results: 在三个VLA架构（GR00T N1.7、π0.5、StableVLA）上，仿真基准（LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin2.0-Plus）绝对成功率提升最高+12%，真实世界部署提升最高+40%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出R2A测试时扩展框架，在不微调基础VLA策略的前提下，利用训练演示中的几何运动基元图检索和门控融合，提升VLA对OOD视觉偏移的鲁棒性。
analysis.method: 构建离线时空运动基元图，推理时通过查询相关的图神经网络定位当前执行并检索未来运动基元，然后使用学习到的维度门控机制将检索到的几何先验与冻结VLA的预测动作融合。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出R2A框架，将VLA策略的OOD鲁棒性构造成运动基元检索问题，通过离线时空运动基元图和图神经网络检索兼容未来运动基元，并用学习到的门控机制修正VLA预测动作。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接面向VLA策略的OOD鲁棒性问题，通过引入显式运动基元先验来修正VLA动作输出，属于VLA执行层面的改进，与本站VLA/WAM主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: World action models (WAMs) predict the visual consequences of the actions they generate, which makes test-time selection a natural way to improve a fixed policy: imagine the futures of candidate actions and execute the best one. The benefit of selection is bounded by the selectable headroom, how much better the best candidate truly is, but the standard estimate, which executes each candidate once and keeps the best outcome, conflates candidate quality with the randomness of everything that follows. We introduce a denoised counterfactual protocol, based on bitwise-reproducible branching, repeated continuations, held-out oracles, and common random numbers, that measures the headroom a selector can realize, and use its measurements to build a fail-gated selector. Across four WAMs, two benchmarks, over 100,000 branched rollouts, and pre-registered tests, we find that (i) the standard estimate overstates the selectable headroom of native samples: bounds from 17 continuations per candidate place its selectable share between 24% and 66% for three WAMs; (ii) structured action perturbations create up to 16 points of selectable headroom; and (iii) in both WAMs with action-conditioned imagination, imagined futures carry candidate-outcome information with no detectable loss relative to real futures, information that the value head of Cosmos Policy leaves unused. Deviating from the policy chunk only when a readout of the WAM predicts failure, the selector raises closed-loop task success from 76.9% to 81.6% on held-out episodes of training tasks, with the largest gain where the policy fails most often, and from 62.6% to 69.8% on unseen tasks.

analysis.key_results: 标准估计高估了原生样本的可选择空间；结构化动作扰动可增加高达16个百分点的可选择空间；想象未来与真实未来在携带候选结果信息方面无显著损失；选择器将闭环任务成功率从76.9%提高到81.6%（训练任务保留集），未见任务从62.6%提高到69.8%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种基于位级可复现分支、重复持续和共同随机数的去噪反事实协议，以准确测量WAM中可由选择器实现的可选择空间（selectable headroom），并构建失败门控选择器实现该空间。
analysis.method: 去噪反事实协议，结合位级可复现分支、重复延续、留出预言机和共同随机数；构建失败门控选择器，仅在WAM读出预测失败时偏离策略块。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出一种去噪反事实协议来测量世界动作模型（WAM）中候选动作的可选择空间，并构建了一个失败门控选择器，在闭环中提升任务成功率。

papers.abstract: In machine learning, symbolic reasoning approaches often rely on static architectures that hinder integration into deep neural networks and gradient-based optimization. To address this, we introduce the Native Predicate Neuron, a differentiable logic-reasoning neural module that enriches standard architectures with symbolic reasoning capabilities via first-order logic quantization. The proposed neuron models relational logic by learning to alternate between operations using a single trainable parameter. It features a tailored gradient mechanism with a dual-nature formulation: executing hard logical operations during training while maintaining differentiability for backpropagation. By quantizing both its input and choice state, the Predicate Neuron approximates continuous and non-continuous functions, effectively resolving discontinuities that standard deep learning architectures struggle with. We evaluate the Predicate Neuron across Fully-Connected, Convolutional, Recurrent, and Transformer architectures on benchmarks like MNIST and Wikitext. Results show that incorporating Predicate Neurons accelerates convergence, boosts accuracy, and lowers loss in general, with particularly strong improvements in tasks requiring monotonic reasoning or handling discontinuities. Overall, the Predicate Neuron natively integrates into standard neural networks to enable fuzzy logic operations and is available in Keras and PyTorch.

analysis.key_results: 在 MNIST 和 Wikitext 基准上，Predicate Neurons 在多种架构（全连接、卷积、循环、Transformer）中加快收敛、提高准确率并降低损失，尤其在需要单调推理或处理不连续性的任务上。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 Native Predicate Neuron，一种可微的逻辑推理神经模块，通过一阶逻辑量化和双性质梯度机制，将符号推理集成到深度神经网络中。
analysis.method: 使用单一可训练参数在操作间交替建模关系逻辑，量化输入和选择状态，采用硬逻辑操作与可微反向传播的定制梯度机制。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种可微的谓词神经元模块，通过一阶逻辑量化和可训练参数在标准神经网络中实现符号推理。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作属于独立模型量化/离散化技术，未直接涉及 VLA、WAM 或机器人策略学习，但所提出的可微量化谓词神经元可能为处理非连续动作或逻辑约束的机器人学习提供方法借鉴。

papers.abstract: World-action models (WAMs) incorporate the prediction of future observations into robot policy learning. However, most WAMs build on billion-parameter vision-language or video-generation backbones, which incur high training cost and inference latency. In this letter, we present GAWM (Geometry-Aware World Model), a compact multi-task WAM that predicts future observations in the latent space of a frozen DINOv3 encoder. GAWM compresses the features of each camera view into a small set of tokens. A lightweight predictor, conditioned on the task rather than on actions, forecasts these tokens at two future horizons. The forecast is supervised with the dense patch features of future frames, which requires it to encode the spatial layout of the future scene. An action decoder directly regresses a chunk of future actions from the current and predicted tokens. With fewer than 100M parameters and no robot or video pretraining, GAWM outperforms billion-parameter WAMs on RoboTwin 2.0 and performs comparably to billion-parameter VLAs on LIBERO. On a dual-arm robot, it achieves lower action-prediction error on held-out demonstrations than a fine-tuned billion-parameter VLA, with substantially lower inference latency. Ablation studies show that the latent world model substantially improves performance when training data or training time is limited. Code is available at https://github.com/gaoxiang12/ga-wm.

analysis.key_results: 在 RoboTwin 2.0 上超越十亿参数 WAM；在 LIBERO 上性能与十亿参数 VLA 相当；在双臂机器人 held-out 演示上动作预测误差低于微调的十亿参数 VLA，推理延迟显著降低；消融实验显示在训练数据或训练时间有限时，隐式世界模型能显著提升性能。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 GAWM（几何感知世界模型），一种紧凑型多任务世界-动作模型，利用冻结 DINOv3 潜在空间的轻量预测器和动作解码器，在极低参数（小于 100M）和零机器人/视频预训练条件下实现高性能动作预测。
analysis.method: 将每个相机视角的特征压缩为少量 token；轻量预测器以任务为条件（而非动作）预测两个未来时间步的 token；用未来帧稠密 patch 特征进行监督，从而编码未来场景空间布局；动作解码器从当前和预测 token 直接回归未来动作块。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 论文提出了一种紧凑的多任务世界-动作模型 GAWM，在冻结的 DINOv3 编码器潜在空间中预测未来观测并直接回归动作序列，以极低参数量和推理延迟超越十亿参数级 WAM/VLA。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文直接针对世界-动作模型（WAM）和机器人视觉-语言-动作（VLA）领域，提出将高效隐式世界建模与动作预测结合的紧凑模型，在降低推理延迟和训练成本的同时保持高性能，与本站 VLA 和 WAM 主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Self-supervised vision transformers are increasingly used as reusable encoders for Earth observation, but their inference cost on the hardware available in the field is rarely characterized. We deploy a pretrained SAR-optical masked-autoencoder encoder on three commodity x86 nodes, from a low-power CPU without AVX2 to an AVX2+VNNI reference, at FP32, FP16 and INT8 on the CPU and, where present, the integrated GPU, and report latency, energy (RAPL and wall plug) and linear-probe accuracy. Quantization is accuracy-neutral: INT8 changes micro-mAP by only +0.0006, within the seed spread, so precision becomes a pure cost decision. INT8 lowers CPU latency on every node, by 1.45x even on the CPU without AVX2, and CPU energy wherever it is measured, and the VNNI reference (1.53x) suggests a further gain beyond AVX2. The Pareto-optimal device shifts from the integrated GPU, which is 4.38x faster than the CPU on the weakest node, to the CPU as the CPU class improves.

analysis.key_results: INT8量化对准确率无负面影响，在CPU上最多降低1.45倍延迟，在AVX2+VNNI节点上降低1.53倍；集成GPU在弱节点上比CPU快4.38倍，但随着CPU改进，最优设备转向CPU。
analysis.main_contribution: 对自监督地球观测视觉Transformer编码器在不同精度和硬件上的推理成本进行了系统表征。
analysis.method: 在三台商用x86节点上部署预训练SAR-光学掩码自编码器编码器，测试FP32、FP16和INT8精度在CPU和可用集成GPU上的延迟、能耗和线性探针准确率。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 部署一个预训练的SAR-光学掩码自编码器编码器到三台商用x86节点上，评估FP32、FP16和INT8精度下的延迟、能耗和线性探针准确率。

papers.abstract: We fine-tuned a separate $\pi_{0.5}$ policy for each of the five tasks in the MetaFine Open Competition, with a task-specific training mixture and number of actions executed per prediction. Training started from the official demonstrations and expert procedures. Local evaluation exposed recurring grasping, pushing, and insertion failures. We addressed them by revising the demonstrated motions and by adding expert continuations from states the policy reached, while keeping nominal demonstrations in training. Checkpoints were compared on every instruction, so that a gain on one instruction could not hide a loss on another. Our submission, MAI, ranked first overall with a score of 96.66.

analysis.key_results: 提交方案MAI在MetaFine公开竞赛中排名第一，总分96.66。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出评估引导的演示精炼方法，针对五个任务分别微调独立的π0.5策略，并通过专家延续和跨指令检查点比较提升整体性能。
analysis.method: 对每个MetaFine任务独立微调π0.5策略，使用任务特定的训练混合和每预测执行动作数；针对抓取、推动和插入失败，修订演示动作并添加从策略到达状态的专家延续，同时保留名义演示；通过比较所有指令上的检查点以防单指令性能提升掩盖其他指令损失。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 通过评估引导的示范精炼和专家延续，对每个任务微调独立的π0.5策略，在MetaFine公开竞赛中取得96.66分排名第一。

papers.abstract: Crowd-counting models deployed on edge devices face two challenges: inputs are degraded along the capture and transmission pipeline, while models are often quantized to satisfy resource constraints of the edge. Yet corruption robustness and deployment quantization are typically evaluated separately. We introduce CrowdCC, a controlled benchmark that jointly evaluates these effects across 23 deployment-motivated corruptions at three severity levels, four crowd-counting datasets, and 26 models. We evaluate TensorRT engines at FP32, FP16, and post-training INT8 precision on an A100 GPU, alongside throughput and energy measurements on corresponding Jetson Orin~NX configurations. The corruptions span six families, with head annotations adjusted when geometry or visibility changes. Our results show that capture-chain corruptions consistently cause the largest degradation across evaluated models, while crowd density affects absolute and relative errors differently. Accuracy on clean images does not reliably predict performance on the corresponding corrupted images. INT8 changes corruption robustness more than FP16, without a consistent direction, and does not consistently improve latency or energy efficiency. INT8 inference efficiency is strongly associated with reformat overhead in the compiled engine, with slowdowns also observed under limited INT8 coverage. Precision changes corrupted-error rankings and robustness--cost frontiers, highlighting the need to consider corruption robustness and deployment cost jointly when selecting models and precision. The code is available at https://github.com/Tulane-Computer-Architecture-Systems/CrowdCC-Release.

analysis.key_results: 捕获链腐败造成最大退化；干净图像上的准确性不能可靠预测腐败图像性能；INT8比FP16更改变腐败鲁棒性，但方向不一致，且不一定改善延迟或能效；INT8推理效率与编译引擎中的重格式化开销强相关。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入CrowdCC基准，在多个数据集、模型、腐败类型和精度配置下联合评估腐败鲁棒性与部署量化效果。
analysis.method: 构建受控基准，包含23种部署动机的腐败、三个严重级别、四个数据集和26个模型；使用TensorRT引擎在FP32、FP16和INT8精度下评估，并在Jetson Orin NX上测量吞吐量和能耗。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出了CrowdCC基准，联合评估人群计数模型在腐败鲁棒性和部署量化（FP32/FP16/INT8）下的表现。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文主要关注人群计数模型的量化与腐败鲁棒性联合基准，未涉及VLA、WAM或机器人动作/世界模型，但量化作为高效推理的关键技术，对边缘部署的机器人模型具有方法参考价值。

papers.abstract: A robot policy needs to understand what a task is asking for in a scene, and how to move the robot to accomplish that task. To achieve these two skills, we introduce Zero-real Agent Policy (ZAP), a recipe that teaches a small off-the-shelf vision-language model to control a robot via a simple tool harness. We use a pretrained 27B parameter model to bootstrap world understanding and reasoning, followed by supervised fine-tuning and GRPO on simple simulated tasks to teach it how to move the robot. Without observing real-world robot data during training, ZAP reaches 96.7% success on real-world tasks, matching GPT-6 Astra in our harness and outperforming the MolmoAct2 VLA (33.3%), while running 3x faster and 17x cheaper than GPT-6 Astra. Furthermore, ZAP also generalizes to an unseen embodiment as well as new objects, goals and strategies never seen during training. On a single-arm Franka, ZAP reaches 55.9% on RoboLab-120, 4.9 percentage points ahead of the leading VLA/WAM baseline.

analysis.key_results: 在真实世界任务中达到96.7%的成功率，超越MolmoAct2 VLA (33.3%)，并在单臂Franka上的RoboLab-120基准上达到55.9%的成功率，比领先的VLA/WAM基线高4.9个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Zero-real Agent Policy (ZAP)，仅使用预训练视觉语言模型和仿真环境进行训练，在没有真实世界机器人数据的情况下，实现高性能的机器人操控和组合泛化。
analysis.method: 使用预训练的27B参数视觉语言模型作为基础，通过仿真环境中的监督微调和GRPO强化学习来训练机器人控制策略。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: ZAP通过仿真训练一个小型视觉语言模型，在零真实数据情况下实现机器人操控，展现出强大的组合泛化能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作属于VLA（视觉-语言-动作）范畴，训练了一个视觉语言模型直接输出机器人动作。它与WAM（世界-动作模型）类似，通过模型理解场景和推理动作，但明确聚焦于利用仿真和预训练实现组合泛化，与本站主题高度相关。

Without using any real robot data in training, ZAP generalizes to completely new objects (test tube), new goals (choosing a different hole in the rack), new strategies (mid-air handoff), and complex skills and reasoning (drawing an X on a tic-tac-toe board, playing chess). papers.abstract: Transformer-based language models exhibit an astonishing capacity to generalize to longer and more difficult problem instances than those seen in training. However, theoretical understanding of this phenomenon still lags behind. Unlike most machine learning models, the generalisation abilities of transformers inherently require considering two axes. On one hand, one must examine in-distribution statistical generalisation, which concerns the ability of a model to broaden a function from training samples to novel samples of the same distribution. On the other hand, given the sequential nature of language data, one must also consider length generalisation, which reflects whether a model trained on inputs of a given length can extrapolate to longer ones. These two notions have mostly been studied separately, leaving open how they interact. In this work, we give a joint treatment of both axes for fixed-precision transformers. We give generalisation guarantees in terms of the parameter sizes of the involved models, as well as the quantization space and the alphabet size that supply the sequences. Finally, we illustrate how the requirements in the sample count and training length trade off. In particular, we find that increasing training length can be exponentially more efficient than increasing the sample size. Experiments support predictions of the theory.

analysis.key_results: 增加训练长度可能比增加样本数量在效率上呈指数级提升；实验支持理论预测。
analysis.main_contribution: 首次联合分析Transformer的分布内统计泛化与长度泛化，给出了以模型参数规模、量化空间和字母表大小为参数的泛化保证，并阐述了样本数量和训练长度之间的权衡。
analysis.method: 针对固定精度多层Transformer的理论泛化分析，推导了依赖于模型参数大小、量化空间和字母表大小的泛化界。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文为固定精度多层Transformer提供了同时考虑分布内泛化和长度泛化的理论泛化保证，并表明增加训练长度可能比增加样本量更高效。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文属于量化模型的理论泛化分析，与VLA（视觉-语言-动作）或WAM（世界-动作模型）无直接关系，但其关于量化模型泛化性的理论结果可能为VLA/WAM中采用量化技术的效率与可靠性提供间接理论参考。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly run on edge devices aboard robots, where inference latency constrains closed-loop robot control. However, it remains unclear how to design VLA models, their inference software and edge hardware so that robots can run VLA inference in real time. Most VLA models report only task success, while prior studies cover limited action-generation strategies, divide inference into at most three stages, and lack comparisons of inference optimizations on the same models. Therefore, we introduce VLA-HWBench, a benchmark that measures 18 open VLA models on NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor and AMD Ryzen AI Max+ PRO 395, with a seven-stage inference breakdown. Our study reveals three insights. First, action-generation strategy matters more than model size. It dominates 14 of 19 Jetson configurations, latency varies by $82\times$ on Jetson and $157\times$ on AMD, and parameter count explains at most 15% of latency variance. Models that generate long action chunks in a few flow-matching steps keep up with control, whereas token-by-token decoding does not. Second, kernel fusion with 4-bit weights helps most, running $\pi_{0.5}$ and GR00T N1.7 2.6-2.9$\times$ faster than PyTorch with torch.compile, but it exists for only these two models and only on the Jetson. Optimization also moves the time to the stages it shortens least, as CPU preprocessing grows from 12% to 39% of the GR00T N1.7 call. Third, after optimization, memory bandwidth limits only the stages that process few tokens on the Jetson, such as the denoising steps, whereas software limits all other stages, from unfused kernels to serial preprocessing on the host CPU. Overall, low-latency edge VLAs should use few action-generation iterations, inference software should extend kernel fusion and low-bit weights to more models and platforms, and edge hardware needs high memory bandwidth and a fast host CPU.

analysis.key_results: 动作生成策略影响最大，延迟在Jetson上变化82倍、AMD上157倍，参数数量仅解释最多15%的延迟方差；内核融合与4位权重使π0.5和GR00T N1.7快2.6-2.9倍，但仅适用于这两种模型且仅在Jetson上；优化后CPU预处理从12%增加到39%，内存带宽仅限制处理少量token的阶段。
analysis.limitations: 内核融合与低比特权重优化目前仅适用于两种模型且仅在Jetson上；优化后CPU预处理成为瓶颈，表明软件栈和硬件配置仍有待改进。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出VLA-HWBench基准，系统测量18个开放VLA模型在两种边缘硬件上的七阶段推理时间分解，揭示了动作生成策略、内核融合和硬件瓶颈对延迟的影响。
analysis.method: 在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor和AMD Ryzen AI Max+ PRO 395上，对18个开放VLA模型进行七阶段推理分解，对比不同动作生成策略、内核融合与低比特权重优化，并分析延迟来源。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文介绍了VLA-HWBench基准，用于测量18个开放VLA模型在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor和AMD Ryzen AI Max+ PRO 395上的七阶段推理分解，以指导实时边缘部署。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接关注VLA模型在边缘硬件上的推理效率，为机器人实时控制提供基准和设计指导，属于VLA核心研究。

papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) combine future-video prediction with robot action learning, yet improvements in task success alone do not reveal how predictive supervision manifests in execution behavior or whether its benefits persist under task and environmental shifts. We conduct controlled future-video prediction loss ablations within FastWAM and OpenWAM, keeping model architecture, initialization, robot training data, and training steps fixed within each model family. Under clean conditions on seen tasks, predictive supervision increases success rates by 24.38 and 72.91 percentage points, respectively. Trajectory clustering further reveals higher success rates within several coarse trajectory clusters, including cases where cluster frequencies change little, indicating that the gains are not solely reflected in changes in the prevalence of trajectory patterns. However, these benefits do not consistently persist under distribution shifts: improvements on unseen tasks vary across models and tasks, while both models exhibit low success rates under the evaluated environmental randomizations, without a consistent advantage from predictive supervision. We further introduce future-video prediction as an auxiliary training objective for $\pi_{0.5}$, where a lightweight Transformer predictor used only during training increases success from 82.94% to 89.19%. These findings support future-video prediction as effective auxiliary supervision for action learning, while distinguishing improved execution on familiar tasks from reliable transfer and showing that such gains need not rely on a large pretrained video diffusion transformer (DiT) in the evaluated setting.

analysis.key_results: 在干净条件下，预测监督使成功率分别提高24.38和72.91个百分点；轨迹聚类揭示成功率提升并不完全体现在轨迹模式分布变化上；在分布偏移下，未见任务上的改进因模型和任务而异，环境随机化下两种模型成功率均低且无一致优势；将未来视频预测作为辅助目标使π0.5成功率从82.94%提升至89.19%。
analysis.limitations: 预测监督的增益在分布偏移下不能一致保持，未见任务和环境随机化下的优势不稳定。
analysis.main_contribution: 通过在FastWAM和OpenWAM中进行受控的未来视频预测损失消融，深入分析了预测监督对机器人动作执行行为的改善及其在任务和环境分布偏移下的泛化局限性，并展示了未来视频预测作为辅助训练目标对π0.5的增益。
analysis.method: 在保持模型架构、初始化、机器人训练数据和训练步数一致的条件下，对FastWAM和OpenWAM进行未来视频预测损失消融；采用轨迹聚类分析动作执行模式；将未来视频预测作为辅助训练目标应用于π0.5，使用轻量级Transformer预测器仅在训练时使用。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 对世界动作模型进行未来视频预测损失的受控消融研究，揭示其对机器人动作学习的增益及其在分布偏移下的局限性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文以世界动作模型为核心研究对象，直接探讨未来视频预测监督对机器人动作学习的影响，对理解WAM的有效性和设计轻量级辅助监督具有高度相关性。

papers.abstract: Interactive world models hold immense potential for high-stakes applications in robotics, game engines, and immersive digital twins, yet existing benchmarks primarily focus on perceptual similarity rather than the physical-causal coherence essential for real-world utility. We introduce WMEval, a comprehensive benchmark that evaluates interactive world models against Unity-based physical simulations. By leveraging Unity as a high-fidelity ground-truth oracle, we shift evaluation beyond perceptual visual assessment toward the objective state-based verification required for downstream applications. Spanning 9 diverse scenes, WMEval assesses action controllability, scene and character consistency, prompt adherence, kinematics, fluid mechanics, physical causality, and lighting. By executing matched action sequences in both the simulator and the world model, WMEval enables evaluation at both the perceptual level and the physical-causal level, using simulator-derived states as reference. Experiments on state-of-the-art models reveal significant room for improvement in dimensions that remain hidden by standard perceptual metrics but are vital for real-world deployments. Our code is available at: https://github.com/hao-ai-lab/WMEval.

analysis.key_results: 在现有最先进模型上的实验表明，在标准感知指标掩盖但实际部署重要的维度上仍有显著改进空间。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 WMEval 基准，利用 Unity 作为高保真真值，对交互式世界模型进行状态级物理因果评估，涵盖 9 个场景和多个维度。
analysis.method: 在模拟器和世界模型中执行匹配的动作序列，以模拟器状态为参考，在感知层面和物理因果层面进行评估。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: WMEval 是一个基于 Unity 物理仿真的交互式世界模型评估基准，超越感知相似度，侧重于物理因果一致性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接针对世界模型（World Model）的评估，强调物理因果一致性和动作可控性，与人形机器人世界模型（WAM）的核心挑战高度契合，对 VLA/WAM 评估具有方法借鉴价值。

(d, e, i) Spatial & Identity Consistency: ChessBoard, MirrorRollingBall, and WanderingGarden test scene geometry preservation, object permanence, and character identity. papers.abstract: Continuous visual world simulation requires coupling evolving scene geometry with temporally persistent appearance. We present UniWorld, a unified framework that integrates depth trajectories and reference appearance within a shared video generation model. The central design maintains visual and geometric histories on a common timeline. Noise-aligned overlapping continuation places generated history at the prescribed sampling noise level and commits only newly generated latents. Rolling depth latent state preserves the corresponding geometric controls, incrementally reads newly available geometry, and keeps the conditioning fixed within each sampling window. Together, these mechanisms ensure exact preservation of latent history while bounding the active depth state by the window size. We evaluate continuous generation, paired history interventions, and long-horizon behavior across diverse scene categories. The same generator supports estimated, native, and on-demand simulator depth, while cached and incremental execution paths produce bitwise-identical outputs. Appearance changes and geometric control branches operate through the same interface without modifying committed history. The measured steady-state DiT execution path achieves real-time generation throughput, demonstrating the efficiency of UniWorld for continuous visual world simulation. Project page: https://zephipage.github.io/UniWorld.

analysis.key_results: 在多样化场景类别上评估连续生成、配对历史干预和长时间跨度行为；缓存与增量执行路径产生逐位相同输出；稳定态DiT执行路径实现实时生成吞吐。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出UniWorld，一种统一的世界模型框架，通过噪声对齐重叠延续、滚动深度潜在状态等机制，在共享视频生成模型中实现连续视觉世界模拟，并支持实时生成吞吐。
analysis.method: 集成深度轨迹与参考外观于共享视频生成模型；采用噪声对齐重叠延续、滚动深度潜在状态机制，确保潜在历史精确保持，同时将有源深度状态限制在窗口大小内。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出UniWorld统一框架，在共享视频生成模型中整合深度轨迹与参考外观，实现连续视觉世界模拟并达到实时生成吞吐。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文是视觉世界模型方向的独立工作，强调实时高效生成，可为机器人世界建模与基于视频的仿真提供高效生成基础，但未直接涉及VLA或机器人动作预测。

Each continuation window packs video history, depth/control, reference, and separator tokens into a shared DiT sequence. Overlapping positions are retained, only the newly required depth suffix is read, and only the newly generated video suffix is committed to the output stream.

papers.abstract: World Models (WMs) can support Multimodal Agents (MAs) through simulated experience, while Agent trajectories can inform World Model refinement. Evaluating this interaction requires separate evidence about action selection and state evolution. We introduce Dual Exam, which tests Agents under fixed environment response mechanisms and World Models under fixed action interventions across physical, digital, social, and scientific domains. The Agent track compares 10 configurations on 1,088 items in 15 reporting categories. The World Model track contains 400 cases across eight scenarios; 15 configurations have full coverage and one covers six scenarios. GPT 6 Astra leads the case-weighted Agent Index at 31.3, and GPT-Image-2 leads the full-coverage WM Overall at 21.7. These scores use different tasks and metrics and are not directly comparable. A 150-case pilot of one coupled pairing records zero task successes and motivates component-level diagnosis. Results reveal uneven task performance and failures to preserve task-relevant state. Their value for predicting coupled success or sustained reciprocal learning remains to be established.

analysis.key_results: GPT 6 Astra 在案例加权 Agent Index 上领先（31.3），GPT-Image-2 在全覆盖 WM Overall 上领先（21.7）；但两项分数使用不同任务和指标，不可直接比较；150案例的耦合配对试点记录零任务成功。
analysis.limitations: 摘要指出分数不可直接比较，且这些结果对于预测耦合成功或持续互惠学习的价值尚未确立。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 Dual Exam 框架，在物理、数字、社会和科学领域分别评估多模态智能体和世界模型，并报告了各自赛道的性能分数。
analysis.method: 通过固定环境响应机制测试智能体，通过固定动作干预测试世界模型；设置 Agent 赛道和 World Model 赛道，并包含一个150案例的耦合配对试点。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一个受控评估框架，分别测试多模态智能体在固定环境响应下的动作选择，以及世界模型在固定动作干预下的状态演变。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文关注世界模型的评估及其与智能体的交互，但与机器人视觉语言动作模型（VLA）或机器人世界模型（WAM）无直接关联；其评估方法可能对机器人世界模型的基准测试有方法论参考价值。

papers.abstract: Robust manipulation of soft objects, such as garments, is a critical skill for service and household robots to adopt, but remains challenging due to its high-dimensional state space, and material-dependent deformations. Humans address this challenge by using mental world models that "imagine" the shape and material properties from partial observations, which enables them to predict how actions affect future states. As such, embedding such world models in robots allows for better generalization in manipulating a wide variety of garments in the real world. However, learned world models typically require large amounts of real world data that is strenuous to collect, and a mechanism to infer latent properties that govern dynamics. We present a Soft-Object World Model that performs generative full-state estimation and action-conditioned dynamics prediction using a transformer backbone trained on large-scale simulated soft object interactions, with measures to mitigate the sim-to-real gap. By learning to infer latent shape and material cues through in-context learning over a variable-length partial point-cloud history, the model generalizes across robot embodiments, material parameters, garment types and shapes, and manipulation coordination modes without weight updates. The world model is then integrated with a Goal-Conditioned action planner for motion synthesis. We validate the approach in simulation and real world for bimanual garment folding, reporting improvements in reconstruction fidelity, prediction accuracy, and task success. Project Website: https://1am5hy.github.io/ICL soft object world model/

analysis.key_results: 在仿真和真实世界的双臂叠衣任务中，重建保真度、预测精度和任务成功率均有提升。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一个软体物体世界模型，通过在大规模模拟软体交互数据上训练Transformer，使用变长局部点云历史的上下文学习来推断潜在形状和材料线索，无需权重更新即可跨机器人形态、材料参数、衣物类型和操作模式泛化，并集成目标条件动作规划器。
analysis.method: 使用Transformer骨干在模拟软体交互数据上训练世界模型，通过上下文学习从变长局部点云历史中推断潜在形状与材料属性，进行生成式全状态估计和动作条件动力学预测，并集成目标条件动作规划器进行运动合成。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一个基于Transformer骨干的软体物体世界模型，利用大规模模拟数据和上下文学习实现生成式全状态估计与动作条件动力学预测，并集成目标条件动作规划器用于真实双臂叠衣任务。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文聚焦于机器人操作中的世界模型，属于WAM（世界模型）的核心主题，与视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）有方法上的互补性：世界模型可提供内部前向预测以支持更稳健的动作生成，尤其针对软体物体操作的高维变形动力学。

papers.abstract: The goal of a world model is to capture the dynamics of an environment. This has the great appeal that it allows agents to plan and simulate a course of actions with the help of a world model. For these uses to be reliable, however, the learned dynamics must behave well beyond the specific state-action combinations observed in expert rollouts. Despite this, the relationship between data coverage, dynamics generalization, and downstream planning performance remains underexplored. We study this relationship through the lens of compositional generalization: can a world model recombine familiar state and action factors into valid dynamics? To answer this, we introduce AnyGoal, a benchmark of goal-shifted task variants built from widely used world-model environments, together with an open-source library. Each task is designed to be within reach of a world model that has learned the underlying dynamics: individual state factors and actions remain within their training support, but their combinations are underrepresented in expert trajectories. Across multiple environments and world model families, we find that current models consistently exhibit failures under these recombinations. By examining dynamics and representation failures across model families, interaction regimes, and evaluation metrics, we study where current world models generalize and where challenges remain for goal-shifted prediction and planning. Together, this framework, benchmark, and analysis provide a basis for evaluating progress toward world models that generalize to new planning tasks.

analysis.key_results: 当前模型在这些重组任务中持续失败；通过分析动态和表示失败，揭示各模型家族、交互机制和指标下的泛化差异。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入 AnyGoal 基准和开源库，系统研究数据覆盖、动态泛化与下游规划性能之间的关系，揭示现有世界模型在目标偏移任务上的组合泛化失败。
analysis.method: 构建目标偏移任务变体（goal-shifted task variants），保持状态因素和动作在训练支持内但组合不足，并在多个环境和世界模型家族上进行评估。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出基准 AnyGoal，用于评估世界模型在目标偏移任务上的组合泛化能力，并分析当前模型在分布外动态预测和规划中的失败模式。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接针对世界模型的泛化评估，与本站世界模型主题高度相关。虽然未显式涉及机器人 VLA 或 WAM，但其基准和分析为改进世界模型在规划任务中的鲁棒性提供了评估基础，对机器人世界模型研究具有方法论价值。

In Push-T, action interventions reveal reduced model sensitivity in biased regions, suggesting that the model learns shortcuts rather than reusable dynamics.

papers.abstract: Bimanual manipulation with dexterous hands has attracted growing attention in research on robotic action models. However, few studies have developed benchmarks specifically tailored for dexterous manipulation, leaving the dexterous manipulation capabilities of existing models insufficiently characterized. In this paper, we present BiDex-100, a simulation benchmark for bimanual dexterous manipulation that combines broad task coverage, multi-dimensional evaluation, and high-DoF hand embodiments. Concretely, the benchmark comprises 106 tasks organized along five capability axes: generalization, instruction following, limited demonstrations, long horizon, and memory. Each task is paired with an out-of-domain variant featuring controlled visual and spatial changes, allowing systematic assessment of robustness. In addition, the benchmark supports two embodiments and provides 8,080 success-validated teleoperated demonstrations, totaling 6.25 million frames. We evaluate seven recent Vision-Language-Action models under a unified protocol, establishing baselines for capability-specific performance, robustness, and data efficiency. The website is available at https://robbyant-research.github.io/BiDex-100/.

papers.abstract: Looped Transformers improve parameter efficiency by applying shared Transformer blocks over recurrent loops, increasing computational depth without increasing the parameter count. However, KV cache memory still scales with loop count, becoming a key memory bottleneck that limits batch size and inference throughput. KV cache quantization can alleviate this bottleneck, but existing methods often suffer substantial accuracy degradation at aggressive low-precision regimes. We observe that looped Transformers offer a unique opportunity: KV states across loops are highly similar. Based on this observation, we propose ResidualQuant, which uses the final-loop KV states as a reference and represents the remaining loops with low-precision residuals. Our method further combines least-square scaling and rotation-based quantization, as well as loop-wise mixed precision, to enable accurate quantization down to INT2 while retaining efficient reconstruction. Across multiple looped Transformer models and mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks, ResidualQuant consistently improves the accuracy-memory tradeoff over state-of-the-art rotation-based KV quantization. In particular, our method retains accuracy close to BF16 under mixed-precision settings while reducing theoretical KV storage by 80.7%, achieving up to 13.0% higher accuracy than the rotation-based baseline at nearly the same memory budget. On an RTX 5090, reduced KV memory traffic improves fixed-batch decode throughput by up to 3.66x, while the smaller memory footprint enables up to 8x larger batches, improving peak throughput by up to 5.38x.

analysis.key_results: 在多个循环Transformer模型和数学推理及代码生成基准上，ResidualQuant一致优于现有旋转KV量化方法；混合精度下理论KV存储减少80.7%，精度接近BF16；在相近内存预算下比旋转基线准确率高13.0%；在RTX 5090上固定批次解码吞吐提升最高3.66倍，内存占用减小使批次规模提升8倍，峰值吞吐提升最高5.38倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出ResidualQuant方法，通过使用末循环KV状态作为参考、以低精度残差表示其余循环，并结合最小二乘缩放、旋转量化和循环级混合精度，在循环Transformer上实现高达INT2的KV缓存量化。
analysis.method: ResidualQuant：利用末循环KV状态作为参考，对剩余循环的KV残差进行低精度量化；结合最小二乘缩放、旋转量化和循环级混合精度。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出ResidualQuant，利用循环Transformer各循环间KV状态高度相似的特点，通过残差量化和混合精度实现低至2位的高精度KV缓存压缩。

papers.abstract: Diffusion models for structured scientific generation must produce samples satisfying hard geometric constraints imposed by physics, chemistry, or biology, yet inference in these settings is prohibitively slow, demanding hundreds to thousands of neural-function evaluations per sample. We unify eight state-of-the-art models spanning medical volumetrics, molecular conformations, protein backbone design, crystal structure prediction, and multi-view 3D scenes under a single abstraction, Constraint-Manifold Diffusion Models (CMDMs), in which the target distribution is supported on a manifold defined by an externally specified constraint map. All existing acceleration families fail on this class: quantization exhausts memory on high-dimensional volumetric operators; pruning breaks constraint fidelity; fast ODE solvers allow trajectories to drift off the constraint manifold; and feature-caching heuristics are blind to constraint geometry, inducing mode confusion in the high-noise regime. We introduce ManifoldCache, the first training-free, data-free accelerator designed from first principles for CMDMs. The key insight is that the conditional score decomposes orthogonally into a normal component, which enforces constraint satisfaction, and a tangential component, which navigates within the manifold. Exploiting this structure, we prove that the noise-schedule midpoint is a sharp safe-caching boundary: caching before it incurs provably bounded error, while caching after it guarantees a strictly positive fraction of trajectories suffer mode confusion, a gap that persists up to the boundary. We further prove that deeper network blocks admit provably larger certified cache strides within the safe phase, as a consequence of the score decomposition propagating through block Jacobians. The resulting schedule requires no calibration data, along with zero training overhead.

analysis.key_results: 摘要未说明具体数值结果，但指出 ManifoldCache 无需校准数据且零训练开销。
analysis.limitations: 摘要未说明方法的具体限制，只提到现有加速方法（量化、剪枝、快速 ODE 求解器、特征缓存）在 CMDMs 上失败。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 ManifoldCache，首个专为约束流形扩散模型设计的免训练、免数据加速器，通过利用条件分数的法向与切向分解，确定噪声调度中点的安全缓存边界，并证明更深的网络块可获得更大的安全缓存步长。
analysis.method: 将条件分数分解为法向分量（约束满足）和切向分量（流形内导航），证明噪声调度中点为安全缓存边界，并利用分数分解通过块雅可比传播证明更深层网络可支持更大的缓存步长。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 论文提出 ManifoldCache，一种针对约束流形扩散模型（CMDMs）的免训练、免数据加速方法，利用分数分解的正交结构实现安全缓存。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于约束流形扩散模型的推理加速，不直接涉及 VLA 或世界模型；但其免训练缓存方法对扩散式机器人策略或世界模型的高效推理具有潜在借鉴价值。

papers.abstract: Long-form thinking traces can substantially improve the multi-step reasoning performance of large language models (LLMs), but they introduce high inference-time overhead, with latency dominated by sequential decoding. We propose HyperThink, a text-to-parameter approach that amortizes this reasoning computation into a single query-conditioned parameter update: a lightweight hypernetwork reads the question and predicts updates to a small subset of the base LLM's parameters, while a vector-quantized decoder constrains them to a finite set of reusable patterns to improve robustness and transfer. Trained end-to-end on outputs from the base model itself, HyperThink eliminates long thinking traces at test time: after one hypernetwork forward pass, the adapted model generates a concise step-by-step solution and final answer without an intermediate trace, using far fewer tokens while retaining strong reasoning performance. Empirically, HyperThink improves the low-latency region of the accuracy-latency trade-off on mathematical and general reasoning tasks, with its strongest gains in the near-non-thinking regime.

analysis.key_results: 在数学和通用推理任务上改进准确率-延迟权衡的低延迟区域，在近乎非思考机制下增益最强。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出HyperThink框架：轻量超网络读取问题并预测基础LLM小部分参数的更新，结合向量量化解码器约束有限可重用模式，在测试时消除长思考轨迹，用更少token生成简洁解答，同时保持强推理性能。
analysis.method: 超网络根据问题预测参数更新，向量量化解码器将更新约束为有限可重用模式，端到端训练于基础模型自身输出。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出HyperThink，一种用超网络将LLM的逐步推理计算摊销为一次性参数更新的文本到参数方法，以降低推理延迟。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文是独立的模型量化与高效推理方法，不直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人，但所提参数高效自适应技术可能对具身模型部署有借鉴价值。

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates language model inference by verifying multiple draft tokens in a single target-model pass. Recent parallel drafters have achieved breakthrough performance in frontier production models, but their effectiveness deteriorates as the entropy of target distributions increases due to insufficient draft diversity. To overcome this bottleneck without sacrificing parallelism, we introduce UBTree, a parallel drafter that couples a Unigram proposer with a Bigram selector to construct drafting Trees. The unigram proposer is trained with the standard cross-entropy objective to generate candidate tokens independently for each position, while a lightweight bigram selector predicts transition scores between adjacent candidate pairs. Unlike the proposer, the selector is trained with a renormalized KL objective on high-temperature data. This tree-native training broadens the supervision beyond the greedy path, encouraging plausible alternative branches that improve the chance of accepting additional tokens during tree verification. Across seven standardized benchmarks with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B, UBTree achieves an average speedup of $5.84$--$6.94\times$ over autoregressive decoding and outperforms DARTree in all 28 comparisons. Production-scale evaluation further demonstrates UBTree's advantage over frontier baselines such as DSpark.

analysis.key_results: 在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B上的七个基准测试中，平均加速比达到5.84–6.94倍，并在所有28个比较中优于DARTree。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出UBTree并行草稿方法，结合一元提议器和二元选择器构建草稿树，缓解并行草稿在高熵场景下多样性不足的问题。
analysis.method: 使用一元提议器独立生成候选tokens，二元选择器预测相邻候选对之间的转移分数，并用重新归一化的KL目标在高温数据上训练选择器。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该文提出UBTree并行草稿方法，通过一元提议与二元选择器构建草稿树，以提升高熵目标分布下投机解码的加速效果。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于语言模型的投机解码加速，未直接涉及VLA（视觉-语言-动作）或WAM（世界-动作模型），但该并行草稿方法可为机器人策略模型的高效推理提供参考。

papers.abstract: Manipulating next-token probabilities during generation can bypass the safety alignment of large language models. Existing approaches, however, rely on access to model weights or numerical token probabilities and therefore do not apply to interfaces that return only sampled text. Reconstructing probabilities from sampled outputs offers a possible alternative, but finite sampling produces sparse and noisy estimates, while repeating this process at every generation step incurs substantial query costs. Our empirical observations suggest that large distributional changes along successful jailbreak trajectories are concentrated at a small subset of positions, motivating selective control. We introduce \method{}, a framework for jailbreaking through text-only continuation interfaces that permit repeated sampling and assistant-prefix continuation. Sample-Based Distribution Reconstruction combines sampled outputs with a prior over unobserved actions to obtain a usable control signal. Risk-Gated Residual Control uses the evolving response prefix to decide when to reconstruct and modify the distribution, concentrating sampling costs at selected positions. Speculative Multi-Token Execution further amortizes target calls by verifying and accepting draft prefixes that require no intervention. Across four target endpoints and three benchmarks, \method{} achieves the highest mean score most comparisons against baselines.

analysis.key_results: 在四个目标端点和三个基准上，该方法在大多数比较中取得最高平均分。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 SBD（基于采样的分布重建）、风险门控残差控制和投机多token执行，在黑盒接口下实现高效的越狱攻击。
analysis.method: 样本分布重建、风险门控残差控制、投机多token执行。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种在黑盒文本接口下通过选择性概率重建与投机多token执行实施越狱攻击的框架。

BiasNet then adjusts this distribution with a gate-scaled residual. papers.abstract: World models jointly learn latent representations and dynamics that predict how high-dimensional observations evolve under actions. In this work, we propose a JEPA-style world model in which, rather than learning arbitrary latent dynamics, we restrict them to follow a bilinear parameterization. This structure enables efficient planning and control while shifting the modeling burden onto the encoder, encouraging richer representations that expose the controllable geometry of the system. In particular, this structured parameterization allows us to structurally enforce action recoverability, thereby preventing representation collapse by construction. Although prescribing a bilinear parametrization may appear restrictive, we show that a broad class of nonlinear dynamical systems admits a transformation under which the dynamics become bilinear. Empirically, we show across standard 2D and 3D control tasks that representations with bilinear-parameterized dynamics can be learned directly from high-dimensional observations, reducing planning time by nearly three orders of magnitude while retaining or even improving control accuracy. We also propose more demanding regimes of longer-horizon planning and real-time control, and demonstrate that our method succeeds in both, moving JEPA-style world models beyond short-horizon offline planning.

analysis.key_results: 在标准2D和3D控制任务中，可以直接从高维观测学习双线性动力学表示，规划时间降低近三个数量级，同时保持或提高控制精度；在更长视界规划和实时控制场景中也成功。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种JEPA风格的世界模型，将潜在动力学限制为双线性参数化，从而高效规划与控制，并增强表示的可控性。
analysis.method: JEPA风格世界模型，采用双线性参数化的潜在动力学，并结构性强制动作可恢复性以防止表示坍缩。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种JEPA风格的世界模型，将潜在动力学限制为双线性参数化，从而高效规划与控制，并增强表示的可控性。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown great promise for robotic manipulation by mapping multi-modal semantics to physical actions. However, this mapping inherently struggles to align these coarse-grained semantics with fine-grained temporal execution. It leaves VLA models with limited generalization and insufficient robustness in cluttered environments. To overcome this issue, we propose ActionUNet, an efficient multi-scale fine-tuning framework that enhances pre-trained VLA models with minimal computational cost. ActionUNet first constructs a lightweight temporal U-Net within the temporal-aligned action feature space to fuse hierarchical structural priors, effectively bridging the scale gap between semantics and temporal executions. Recognizing that multi-scale modeling can disrupt microscopic temporal continuity and cause mechanical oscillations, ActionUNet then employs a conditional SIREN as a continuous action decoder. Equipped with explicit second-order smoothness constraints, this decoder guarantees temporal continuity and reduces high-frequency motion jitter. By smoothing temporal discontinuities from multi-scale fusion, this continuous formulation reduces mechanical execution failures while preserving the base VLA model's generalization and manipulation robustness. Extensive experiments on RoboTwin 2.0 and LIBERO-Plus benchmarks, together with real-world hard evaluations, demonstrate that ActionUNet significantly improves {\pi}0.5 success rates by absolute 9.8%, 6.1%, and 11.4%, respectively, while also generalizing to the regression-based OpenVLA-OFT backbone, highlighting its effectiveness and efficiency as a fine-tuning strategy. Code and implementation details are available at https://github.com/Di-Zhu123/ActionUNet.

analysis.key_results: 在RoboTwin 2.0和LIBERO-Plus基准以及真实世界评估中，ActionUNet显著将π0.5成功率分别绝对提升9.8%、6.1%和11.4%，并且可泛化到基于回归的OpenVLA-OFT骨干网络。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出ActionUNet，一种高效的多尺度微调框架，用于增强预训练VLA模型，以最小计算代价提升其在杂乱环境中的泛化性和鲁棒性。
analysis.method: 在时间对齐的动作特征空间中构建轻量时序U-Net以融合层次结构先验，并采用带二阶平滑约束的条件SIREN作为连续动作解码器，减少运动抖动并保证时间连续性。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出ActionUNet框架，通过在时间对齐的动作特征空间引入轻量级时序U-Net和条件SIREN连续动作解码器，以高效微调提升VLA模型的时序一致性和鲁棒性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 研究聚焦于VLA模型的微调以提高动作预测的时间一致性和鲁棒性，与机器人操作任务紧密相关。虽然未涉及世界模型或无缝衔接WAM，但通过改进VLA动作解码，对机器人动作预测具有直接价值。

papers.abstract: Four-bit post-training quantization can reduce the memory demands of large language models, but preserving accuracy under strict MXFP4 W4A4 requires coordinating several design choices. Coordinate transforms change block-encoding errors, which in turn affect the residuals propagated through the network. The useful algorithmic decomposition is therefore not fully known before search. LLM-driven program evolution offers a way to explore these choices, but performance scores alone do not explain which design should change next. We introduce QuantForge, a PTQ discovery system that records competing explanations, selects controls that distinguish them, and checks that successor code implements the resulting conclusions. This residual compilation guides program revisions while retaining useful programs even when their original explanations are rejected. Remeasuring the revised program reveals the next error to address. This process discovers HiRes, a fixed MXFP4 quantizer that shapes coordinates, refines legal code assignments, and recovers errors along attention and MLP paths. Each stage acts on residuals measured after the preceding stage has executed. Across seven tasks, HiRes achieves the lowest seven-model Robust Fit (0.09300) and the lowest quantized Fit-7 at 32B. In matched-budget comparisons of LLM-driven program evolution, each with 240 evaluator calls, QuantForge reaches a held-out transfer target in six of eight runs, compared with three each for textual memory and reflection memory, and one for score-only evolution, despite evaluating fewer new programs. These results show that QuantForge improves the discovery of transferable PTQ algorithms by turning controlled evidence into subsequent program changes. We have open-sourced the QuantForge search framework.

analysis.key_results: HiRes 在七个任务上取得最低的七模型 Robust Fit（0.09300）和 32B 规模最低的量化 Fit-7；在 240 次评估器调用的预算对比中，QuantForge 在八次运行中有六次达到留出迁移目标。

papers.abstract: Developers download quantized large language models (LLMs) from public registries to run them locally. None of the registries we examined documented functional testing of their files. We tested all 305 eligible code-capable GGUF tags (the llama.cpp format) across 15 model lines in the official Ollama library, plus 22 popular Hugging Face community files. A 15-task code screen identified suspects, which we retested on all 164 HumanEval+ tasks. Seven official tags (2.3%) solved at most six of them. All were low-bit quantizations of models with at most four billion parameters. We rebuilt five suspect files from the original weights. All five registry files matched our uncalibrated rebuilds tensor for tensor, so none was corrupted. Exact reproducibility did not imply function. With the weights, toolchain and tensor mix held fixed, adding an importance matrix raised Qwen2.5-Coder-3B scores at three quantization levels from zero to 76-113 of 164 tasks. The same uncalibrated recipe left the smaller Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B functional, showing that the recipe alone does not predict failure. None of 66 sampled tags that passed the screen was non-functional. We release the audit data and the quantcheck tool and recommend screening low-bit tags before publication, then calibrating or withholding failures.

analysis.key_results: 7个官方标签（2.3%）最多只能解决6个任务；5个可疑文件重建后与注册表文件逐张量匹配，排除损坏；加入重要性矩阵使Qwen2.5-Coder-3B在三个量化级别上从0分提升到76-113分；66个通过筛查的标签均未出现非功能。
analysis.main_contribution: 对Ollama官方库和Hugging Face社区中305个代码能力的量化模型进行功能性测试，识别出7个非功能模型（均为低比特量化的小参数模型），并证明通过重要性矩阵校准可以恢复功能。
analysis.method: 使用15项代码任务筛选，并对疑似模型在全部164个HumanEval+任务上重测；重建可疑文件进行逐张量比对；通过添加重要性矩阵校准量化过程。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文审计了公开模型注册表中的量化LLM，发现部分低比特量化模型功能失效，并提出了筛查工具和校准修复方法。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文针对通用LLM量化伪影的功能性失效问题，未涉及VLA、WAM或机器人领域。但其提出的筛查方法和校准方案对于量化机器人策略或世界模型具有直接的方法学参考价值。

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by using a draft model to generate candidate tokens, which are verified by the target model in a single forward pass. Verification proceeds sequentially and discards every position from the first rejection onward, yet existing draft training relies on token-level imitation of the target with a fixed per-position weighting that reflects neither property. We introduce Verification-Aware Training (VAT), a plug-in framework that simulates verification at every training step and turns the resulting accept and reject patterns into supervision. VAT consists of two components: (i) a verification head, a lightweight jointly trained binary classifier that supervises the draft model on whether each position survives sequential verification; (ii) verification-adaptive weighting, which replaces the fixed weighting schedule by keeping full weight up to each sample's first rejection point and re-anchoring the decay to start there. VAT modifies only the training objective, so it can be layered on top of existing methods without changing the draft architecture, the target model, or the inference procedure. Applied to EAGLE-3 and DFlash on Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, and LLaMA-3.1-8B, VAT improves average acceptance length by up to 11.4% and wall-clock speedup by up to 8.7%, with consistent gains across math, code, and chat benchmarks. Code will be available at https://github.com/naver-ai/vat

analysis.key_results: 在Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B和LLaMA-3.1-8B上应用于EAGLE-3和DFlash，平均接受长度提升最高11.4%，墙钟加速最高8.7%，在数学、代码和聊天基准上均有提升。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出验证感知训练框架VAT，包括验证头（二分类器）和验证自适应权重，以模拟推测解码验证过程并以此监督草稿模型。
analysis.method: VAT框架，包含一个轻量级联合训练的二分类验证头，监督草稿模型每个位置是否能通过顺序验证，以及验证自适应权重，将权重保持到第一个拒绝点并重新锚定衰减。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出验证感知训练（VAT），通过模拟验证过程来改进草稿模型的训练，从而提升推测解码的接受长度和加速效果。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于推测解码这一独立的高效推理方法，没有直接涉及机器人或世界模型；但其方法可潜在地应用于基于Transformer的机器人策略或世界模型，以加速推理。

At each training step, VAT simulates target verification by comparing the target and draft predictions at every position k k , yielding acceptance labels v k v_{k} . In this example, the first mismatch occurs at k ∗ = 3 k^{*}=3 , so all subsequent positions are labeled reject . The labels drive two components: (i) verification-adaptive weighting, which replaces the fixed schedule w k w_{k} with w ^ k \hat{w}_{k} by keeping full weight up to k ∗ k^{*} and re-anchoring the base decay to start at k ∗ k^{*} , and (ii) a lightweight verification head on top of the draft’s hidden states, trained to predict per-position acceptance v ^ k \hat{v}_{k} . The final objective combines the reweighted cross-entropy losses with the verification head loss ℒ VH \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{VH}} .

papers.abstract: Single-GPU deployment of 70B-parameter language models on an NVIDIA GPU is constrained by device memory, long-context throughput, and engineering integration cost. We cast single-GPU inference as a budget-aware design problem over these three axes and study how pruning, quantization, and KV-cache compression interact under realistic execution. Controlled ablations show that layer-wise pruning makes weight quantization more robust. KV-cache sparsification complements INT8 KV quantization by reducing memory without hurting decoding speed, while static vector quantizers often conflict with dynamic caching. Guided by these coupling results and explicit budget tracking, we assembled a practical pipeline and compressed a 70B model to about 33 GB, sustained about 57 tokens/s on 10k token prompts on a single A40, and kept absolute accuracy within 5% on common and reasoning benchmarks. We contribute design rules and a reproducible evaluation protocol that jointly report quality, memory, and end-to-end speed, and we provide a foundation for automated pipeline search under realistic single-GPU constraints.

analysis.key_results: 压缩后70B模型大小约33GB，在单块A40上10k token提示下持续生成速度约57 tokens/s，在常见与推理基准上绝对精度保持在5%以内。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了一个预算感知的压缩流水线，并总结了在单GPU约束下剪枝、量化（权重和KV缓存）之间相互作用的实证设计规则。
analysis.method: 采用预算感知设计框架，通过受控消融实验研究层级剪枝、权重量化（INT8 KV）、KV缓存稀疏化以及静态向量量化之间的交互关系，并组装实用压缩流程。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 论文研究单GPU上70B LLM部署中剪枝、量化和KV缓存压缩在内存、速度和精度之间的耦合与权衡，并提出预算感知压缩流水线。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文关注的是通用大语言模型的单GPU高效推理，主要涉及剪枝、量化和KV缓存压缩的耦合，未直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人动作世界模型。其方法论（联合报告质量、内存和端到端速度的评估协议）对后续在机器人策略或世界模型中引入量化等高效推理技术具有参考价值。

papers.abstract: Robots executing long-horizon manipulation tasks from natural-language instructions must reason about both semantic task structure and geometric feasibility. Hierarchical approaches combining Vision-Language Models (VLMs) with Task and Motion Planning (TAMP) offer a promising solution, but VLM-generated subgoals may rely on prior knowledge without sufficient observational support. This can lead to the omission of task-relevant subgoals or attempts to execute instructions whose requirements cannot be met in the environment. We propose Evidence Acquisition and Feasibility Gating (EAFG), a framework for evidence-gated task and motion planning that acquires visual evidence to specify appropriate task plans and assess whether given instructions can be fulfilled. EAFG first acquires evidence by having a VLM generate subgoals and a robot execute action sequences planned by TAMP for these subgoals. For feasibility gating, the acquired evidence is used to decide whether to proceed with task planning, acquire further evidence, or halt. When proceeding, the VLM generates task subgoals conditioned on the acquired evidence, and TAMP computes low-level actions. We evaluate EAFG in three cooking scenarios involving explicitly specified required objects, underspecified instructions, and instructions requiring an absent object. EAFG improves task completion over a VLM-TAMP baseline in the explicit and underspecified scenarios and enables appropriate halting when a required object is absent.

analysis.key_results: 在三种烹饪场景（显式指定物体、欠指定指令、需要缺失物体）中，EAFG在显式和欠指定场景中提升了任务完成率，并在物体缺失时能适当停机。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出证据门控任务与运动规划框架（EAFG），在VLM-TAMP基础上引入证据获取与可行性门控机制，能够根据环境证据决定继续规划、获取更多证据或终止执行。
analysis.method: EAFG框架：先由VLM生成子目标并由TAMP规划执行以获取证据，随后根据证据进行可行性门控（继续、获取更多证据或停机），最终在条件证据下重新生成子目标并计算底层动作。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出EAFG框架，通过获取视觉证据来门控任务与运动规划，提升机器人执行长程操作任务时对语义和几何可行性的推理能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文研究视觉语言模型与任务运动规划的结合，属于机器人操作与VLA相关领域。它不涉及世界模型或动作世界模型，但为提高VLA系统在长程任务中的可靠性和环境适应性提供了方法参考。

papers.abstract: Recent vision-language navigation (VLN) systems increasingly adapt pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) into vision-language-action (VLA) policies that map egocentric observations and language instructions directly to navigation actions. Although semantically capable, such action-centric training does not explicitly model how the agent's visual observations evolve under its predicted motion. Generative world-action models (WAMs) jointly predict future observations and actions, yet existing WAMs for continuous VLN do not condition joint future-view and action generation on geometry-aware representations inferred from the observation history. We present WNM-3D, a generative World Navigation Model with 3D scene conditioning for continuous VLN. A frozen feed-forward geometry encoder extracts cross-view representations from monocular RGB history, and a trainable 3D Scene-to-Token Adapter converts them into a fixed-length scene prefix for the world-action Diffusion Transformer. Through block-causal attention, this prefix remains visible to every future video-action block throughout joint denoising, providing persistent geometric context. We train WNM-3D with supervised world-action learning, DAgger-style adaptation on policy-visited states, and Counterfactual DanceGRPO refinement. Across GN-Bench and VLN-CE, WNM-3D consistently outperforms the backbone-matched WNM-2D counterpart, demonstrating gains from 3D scene conditioning across distinct visual domains. WNM-3D further outperforms strong VLN baselines on GN-Bench and demonstrates closed-loop deployment on a physical robot. Component and stage-wise ablations support the Adapter design and the complementary roles of DAgger-SFT and subsequent reward-guided refinement.

analysis.key_results: 在GN-Bench和VLN-CE上一致优于主干匹配的WNM-2D，并在物理机器人上实现闭环部署。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出WNM-3D，将冻结的3D几何编码器与可训练的Scene-to-Token Adapter结合，为世界-行动扩散Transformer提供持久的几何上下文。
analysis.method: 使用监督世界-行动学习、DAgger式策略访问状态适应和反事实DanceGRPO精细化训练世界-行动扩散Transformer。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出WNM-3D，一个通过三维几何场景条件增强的生成式世界行动模型，用于连续视觉语言导航并实现闭环机器人部署。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接聚焦于视觉语言导航中的世界行动模型（WAM），通过3D场景条件提升连续动作和未来观测的联合生成，是WAM在机器人导航中的具体应用，且与VLA策略的训练和部署紧密相关。

papers.abstract: Quantized Neural Networks~(QNN) with low-bitwidth data have proven promising in efficient storage and computation on edge devices. To mitigate accuracy degradation while maximizing speedup, layer-wise mixed-precision quantization~(MPQ) becomes a popular solution. However, existing algorithms for exploring MPQ schemes are limited in flexibility and efficiency. Comprehending the complex impacts of different MPQ schemes on post-training quantization and quantization-aware training results is a challenge for conventional methods. Furthermore, an end-to-end framework for the optimization and deployment of MPQ models is missing in existing work. To address these challenges, we propose the MiCo framework, a holistic MPQ exploration and deployment framework for edge AI applications. The framework adopts a novel optimization algorithm to search for accuracy-optimal quantization configurations under strict latency constraints. We further extended the framework to MiCoPro, which introduces a robust Hardware-Aware Proxy (HAP) model to enhance prediction accuracy and hardware versatility. By leveraging target-specific latency modeling, MiCoPro enables rapid exploration and direct deployment from PyTorch models to bare-metal C code. We demonstrate the versatility of our framework on both the BitFusion accelerator and SIMD-extended RISC-V processors, achieving up to 40\% of latency reduction with less than 3\% of accuracy drop.

analysis.key_results: 在 BitFusion 加速器和 SIMD 扩展 RISC-V 处理器上实现高达 40% 的延迟降低，准确率下降小于 3%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了端到端的混合精度量化探索与部署框架 MiCoPro，引入硬件感知代理模型提高预测精度和硬件通用性。
analysis.method: 采用硬件感知代理模型进行目标特定延迟建模，在严格延迟约束下搜索精度最优的混合精度量化配置，并支持直接部署到裸机 C 代码。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出 MiCoPro 框架，通过硬件感知代理模型在严格延迟约束下搜索精度最优的混合精度量化方案，并实现从 PyTorch 到裸机 C 代码的快速部署。

papers.abstract: Frozen vision-language-action (VLA) policies generate temporally extended action chunks, but long-horizon manipulation remains vulnerable to accumulated execution error and visual aliasing across task stages. Successful rollouts provide useful corrective evidence, yet current frame retrieval can return progress-misaligned actions,while direct replay or time-domain fusion can overwrite the reactive structure of the policy proposal. We introduce Retrieve in Time, Correct in Frequency (RTCF), a training-free test-time correction framework that improves frozen VLA performance with low model-side overhead.RTCF separates which experience to retrieve from which part of its action to transfer. Progressive Memory Alignment (PMA) causally aligns the growing visual execution history with complete successful trajectories through incrementally updated monotonic frontiers, jointly identifying a relevant memory and the current aligned memory position without stage labels. From the aligned action chunk,RTCF transfers a coefficient-wise-clipped low-frequency residual on motion channels. Higher-frequency components and gripper decisions remain inherited from the frozen policy. Across four LIBERO suites and 2,000 episodes per condition, RTCF raises aggregate success from 86.4% to 88.4% and improves LIBERO-Long from 61.6% to 68.6%.These gains require no parameter updates, repeated VLA inference, or additional GPU resources: correction can be performed on the client CPU after a single policy invocation, and the median latencies sum to only 10.99 ms per action chunk

analysis.key_results: 在四个LIBERO套件上，聚合成功率从86.4%提升到88.4%，LIBERO-Long从61.6%提升到68.6%，中位延迟每个动作块仅10.99毫秒。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出训练自由的测试时校正框架RTCF，通过渐进记忆对齐和时间-频率解耦，在不更新参数、不增加GPU资源的情况下提高冻结VLA策略的成功率。
analysis.method: RTCF利用渐进记忆对齐因果地对齐视觉执行历史与成功轨迹，从对齐的动作块中迁移系数裁剪的低频运动残差，高频和夹爪决策保留原始策略输出。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: RTCF是一种无需训练的测试时校正框架，通过对齐执行进度并仅迁移低频运动残差，以极低计算开销提升冻结视觉-语言-动作策略的长期操作性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文直接针对冻结VLA策略的长期操作误差问题，通过测试时校正提升动作预测的时序对齐和鲁棒性，与VLA核心主题高度相关。
